Each time Chang'e casts a skill, she also gains 50% movement speed which decreases over 2.5 seconds. Crescent Moon also causes Chang'e's basic attacks to deal bonus magic damage 2 times. Every time Chang'e deals magic damage with his basic attack and skills, the cooldown of this skill is reduced by 0.2 seconds.

Chang'e fires 30 meteors in the target direction for 4 seconds, each dealing to the first enemy hit. This skill deals 100% more damage to minions and Creeps. Chang'e also gains 10% movement speed for the duration of the effect. Crescent Moon: The Crescent Moon also shoots meteors with Chang'e, each dealing 33% damage.

chip.description: Chip begins eating chips once every 2 seconds outside of combat, regenerating HP equal to 300 plus 45% of HP lost after finishing an entire bag (requires 4 bites). After eating a bag of chips, Chip will be full and will not be able to eat for 5 seconds. (Bite count will be saved if entering combat before completing an entire bag)

Chip drives his hovercraft into the ground, dealing magic damage equal to plus 4% of the target's maximum HP and applying Chip's Mark to enemy units hit. Chip gains one when hitting an enemy hero, which increases by 40% for each additional enemy hero hit. Chip's next basic attack will become ranged and will also hit all nearby enemies with Chip's Mark|e, detonating the mark to inflict and stun each target for 0.6 seconds.

Chip dashes for 2 seconds, gaining up to 65% additional movement speed, after which he maintains maximum speed for 2 seconds. Chip's next basic attack will have him charging at the enemy, damaging them and knocking them back slightly.

Chip drops the main portal on an enemy hero, briefly slowing them by 25%. the main portal deals 2x damage and immobilizes them for 1 second after a delay. During this time, he creates connection portals near allied heroes within 10 units and behind the allied base. The main portal and login portals last up to 15 seconds. Connection Portal: Heroes (from both teams) can teleport from Connection Portals to the main portal, and allied Heroes gain explosive movement speed for 1.5 seconds and a shield. Main Portal: The main portal inherits 70% of Chip's attributes. Heroes can stay in the main portal for 2 seconds to return to the connection portal they came from. Casting skills or launching basic attacks will reset the hold time.
Chip has 4 fixed beacons on the map when the battle begins. Use this skill to teleport to any other beacon. (This skill cannot be used in combat.)

chou.description: After traveling 5 units, Chou deals 180% damage with his next basic attack (can't crit), briefly slows the target by 80%, and reduces his physical defense by 10 (+1*hero level) for 3 seconds (up to 2 charges).

Chou strikes in the targeted direction, dealing damage to enemies hit. This skill can be cast 3 times before entering the cool down phase. On the 3rd throw, Chou also throws enemies hit into the air. Hitting an enemy hero with the 3rd throw resets Shunpo's cooldown.
Chou charges in the target direction, gaining control immunity and a shield.
Chou hits the targeted enemy hero with a roundhouse kick on the targeted enemy hero, dealing damage and knocking them back. Cast this skill again to pursue the target, dealing a total of.

cici.description: Cici generates a stack of Delight after dealing damage, increasing her movement speed by 0.75% and her Vamp spell by 0.75% per stack up to 10 times, doubling the effects on full stacks.

Cici uses Yoyo to continuously attack the closest enemy within range (prioritizing Heroes) for 3.5 seconds, hitting them up to 10 times and dealing a percentage equal to the target's maximum HP per hit. Cici can move and use other skills during this attack. If there are no enemy heroes in range, Yoyo will attack the turrets or base instead. The skill deals 20% more damage to minions.

Cici jumps to a target location. If she lands on any unit (not including turrets and base), she can jump in the direction of the joystick again. If it lands on an enemy from the first jump, it inflicts a spell on them.

Cici casts Yoyo at the targeted enemy hero and links them to another nearby enemy hero, slowing them by 30% and bringing them closer. Meanwhile, Cici can use Yo-Yo Blitz to attack both linked targets at the same time. If only one is within range of Yo-Yo Blitz, Cici will attack the target twice, but the damage of the second attack will be reduced to 25% ~ 45%.

claude.description: Dexter launches an additional attack every time Claude's basic attack lands, dealing to the same target. Dexter's basic attack can also trigger Claude's attack effects with 30% effectiveness.

Claude attacks enemies in a fan-shaped area in front of them, dealing and reducing their movement speed by 20% and attack speed by 10%. For each target hit, Claude gains 3% additional movement and attack speed (doubled if the target is an enemy hero, up to 5 charges) for 6 seconds.

Claude leaves a mirror image of Dexter at a designated location. Dexter's mirror image automatically attacks enemies. Lasts 5.5 seconds. Claude can reactivate this skill to change places with the mirror image. Dexter's basic attack deals and can trigger Claude's attack effects.

Claude and Dexter rapidly fire at nearby enemies for 3 seconds, dealing up to two targets each time they fire. This skill benefits from Claude's basic attack effects and gives him a shield capable of absorbing damage.

clint.description: After each skill cast, Clint's next basic attack within 4 seconds penetrates a line of enemies and deals damage. This damage can trigger attack effects and the party affected by the physical attack can make a critical hit.

Clint fires 5 bullets in rapid succession in the target direction, each dealing damage to the enemy hit. Bullets will spread evenly over enemies in a fan-shaped area. Enemies hit by multiple bullets will take [11% to 16%] damage after the first bullet.

Clint fires a trap in the target direction, jumping back slightly while dealing the first enemy hit and immobilizing them for 1.2 seconds. Successfully hitting an enemy reduces the cooldown of this skill by 40%.

Clint throws a grenade in the target direction which explodes on the enemy's first hit, damaging them and slowing them by 50% for 0.5 seconds. Clint gets a grenade recharge every 10 to 5 seconds (up to 3).

cyclops.description: Each time Cyclops hits an enemy with his skills, all his skill cooldowns are reduced by 0.5 seconds.
Cyclops throws two Stardust Discs, each dealing damage to enemies in its path.

Cyclops conjures up starry spheres around him while gaining 30% movement speed for 2 seconds. Spheres will automatically seek out and attack nearby enemies (prioritizing enemy heroes), exploding on collision and dealing damage to the enemy. Enemies hit by multiple spheres will take reduced damage after the first hit.
Cyclops creates a planetary sphere and sends it after the targeted enemy Hero or Creep, damaging and immobilizing them for 1-2 seconds (increases with movement distance).

diggie.description: When he dies, Diggie reverses time and transforms into an egg, in which he can continue to move and learn a new set of skills. It cannot be targeted in egg form and will resurrect after a while.

Diggie sounds an owl alarm at the target location. The alarm will then remain stationary for 25 seconds or until it reacts to the first enemy within range, chasing them and detonating on collision. The explosion deals damage to nearby enemies and slows them by 30%. Diggie gains 2 stacks of Dangerous Sparks|stack every time an enemy hero is hit by the blast (up to 60 stacks), with each stack increasing the skill's damage by 1%. Diggie loses half the stacks upon death, but can gain 1 stack of Dangerous Sparks each time his skill hits an enemy hero in egg form. Up to 5 owl alarms can exist at the same time.

Diggie marks a targeted enemy Hero for 4 seconds and returns them to their previous location once the duration ends, damaging and slowing them by 80%. If the enemy exits the circle, the shot will be triggered earlier.
Diggie removes all debuffs from nearby allied heroes (including himself) and grants them control immunity for 3 seconds. He also gains 50% movement speed for 0.5 seconds.

dori.description: Dori's skill damage inflicts a mark on targets for 4.5 seconds. Hitting a marked enemy with a skill causes the mark to explode again and deals damage. Each time Dori casts a skill, she gains 30% movement speed for 1 second.
Dori gains a shield for 3 seconds, knocking back and damaging nearby enemies.
After a short delay, Dori attacks enemies in the surrounding area of ​​the ring, slowing them by 30% for 1.5 seconds. She also gains 15% movement speed for 3 seconds.
After a short delay, Dori attacks enemies in a large ring area, stunning them for 1 second.

dyrroth.description: When Dyrroth's Rage reaches 50%, he will upgrade Burst Strike – Abyss Enhanced and Specter Step – Abyss Enhanced. After every 2 basic attacks, Dyrroth will cast the skill Circle Strike|, dealing enemies in the circle and regenerating [50 + 40% of damage dealt|pd HP] (Circle Strike has no ATK effect). Every time it hits an enemy hero, the CD of Burst Strike and Specter Step will be decreased by 1 second.

Dyrroth launches a burst strike in a designated direction. Each burst deals damage to enemies and Slows them by 25% for 1.5 seconds. (Damage decreases against the same target and decreases to only 75%|hp on minions.) Abyss Enhanced|skill: Burst Strike has a longer range, deals 140% of the original damage|hp, and its slow effect is doubled.

Dyrroth rushes in the direction indicated. It will stop when it hits a [non-minion] target, dealing damage to enemies. When he uses this skill again, he will lock on to a target and deliver a fatal strike, dealing [a total of]. Enemy Heroes or Creeps hit by Fatal Strike will have their Physical Defense reduced by 40% for 4 seconds. Abyss Enhanced|skill: Fatal Strike will deal 150% of original damage|pd, slow the target by an additional 90% [for 1 second], and reduce the target's physical defense by 60% [instead] for 4 seconds.
After a short delay, Dyrroth launches a destructive strike in the targeted direction (cannot be interrupted), dealing damage to enemies along the way and slowing them by 55% for 0.8 seconds.

edith.description: After each skill cast, Edith and Phylax become overcharged for 3 seconds, during which all basic attacks will unleash chains of lightning, dealing additional magic damage equal to up to 4 enemies. Chain Lightning damage against minions is increased to 150%.

After a 0.75 second delay, Edith controls Phylax to deliver a devastating blow in a designated direction, dealing 120% damage to minions to enemies hit and knocking them into the air for 1 second. This skill will not be interrupted by regular control effects (excluding Suppression).

Edith controls Phylax to charge in the target direction, dealing damage to enemies along the way. If Phylax hits an enemy hero during this process, he will immediately stop and throw them over his shoulder and deal damage.

Passive: While inside Phylax, Edith can accumulate Wrath based on the damage she receives (calculated before damage reduction). Active: Edith ejects from Phylax, knocking back nearby enemies. After that, she takes flight and can perform ranged basic attacks, each dealing damage. Edith also learns new skills in this state. While flying, Edith gains 350 to 650 to 350 to 650 points of additional shield, 50 to 150% additional attack speed, and 5 to 20% hybrid lifesteal depending on how much anger she has accumulated, and converts each point of additional physical defense and additional magic defense into 3.5 magic power. The flight state lasts up to 8-12 seconds.

After each skill cast, Edith and Phylax become overcharged for 3 seconds, during which all basic attacks will trigger chains of lightning, dealing bonus magic damage equal to (+20% total magic power) plus 3 (+0.2*hero level)% of the target's maximum HP to up to 4 enemies. Chain Lightning damage against minions is increased to 150%.

Edith imposes a divine smite on a target area, dealing 170 (+40% total magic power) magic damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 30%. It then continues to deal 68 (+16% total magic power) magic damage to enemies in the area every 0.5 sec for the next 1.5 sec.
Edith fires a bolt of lightning in a designated direction, dealing 150 (+50% total Magic Power) magic damage to the first enemy Hero hit and Rooting them for 0.8 seconds.

Passive: Inside Phylax, Edith accumulates Wrath based on damage taken (calculated before damage reduction). Active: Edith ejects from Phylax, knocking back nearby enemies and taking flight for up to 8 seconds. During this time, she gains new skills and can perform ranged basic attacks, each dealing 35 (+75% of total physical attack) (+25% of total magic power) magic damage. She also gains 350 (+5% total HP) - 350 (+20% total HP) additional shield, 50% - 150% additional attack speed, and 5% - 20% hybrid lifesteal based on accumulated anger, and converts each point of additional physical defense and additional magic defense into 3.5 magic power.

esmeralda.description: Esmeralda manipulates Stardust and Frostmoon: Stardust deals physical damage while Frostmoon deals magic damage and gives the target a shield equal to 135% of the damage dealt by Frostmoon. Each basic attack deals and. Esmeralda's damage ignores all shield effects and gradually converts her shield into HP. [unknown amount/conversion rate]

Esmeralda gains 40% Movement Speed ​​which rapidly decreases for 4 seconds. During this time, she gradually transforms the shields of nearby enemies into her own shield, [amount unknown] capped at 50% of her Max HP.

Esmeralda waves Stardust and Frostmoon, dealing damage to nearby enemies. Each time she damages a hero, Frostmoon Shield's cooldown is reduced by 1.5 seconds (damaging non-hero units grant a reduction of 0.5 seconds) and the enemy's movement speed is reduced by 10% for 1.5 seconds.

Esmeralda brings together the power of Astrospace in her two weapons: Stardust and Frostmoon. The longer this skill is channeled, the longer the casting range. Use Again|e: Esmeralda casts Stardust at the target location, dealing it, then flashes to the target location and casts Frostmoon, dealing and immobilizing enemies in the area for 1 second.

estes.description: The Moon Elf Scriptures slowly charge Estes with energy. When the energy reaches 100 charges, the Estes' Nest's basic attack will be enhanced, dealing damage to the target and nearby enemies and slowing them by 60% for 1.5 seconds.

Estes immediately restores the target hero and bonds with them for 3 seconds, slowly healing back towards the target. Bonding with an allied hero will also increase Estes' hybrid defense by 20-45 and movement speed by 15%, as well as increase the energy charge speed of the Moon Elf's Scriptures. Being too far from the target will break the link. (Improved:|e Estes immediately restores the target hero and bonds with them for 3 seconds, slowly healing back to the target 15 times...)

Estes projects a flood of moonlight onto the target area, dealing damage to enemy units there. Then it turns to a Moon Goddess domain and reveals the enemies inside [for 1.5 seconds]. Enemies will be slowed by 90% for 1.5 seconds when touching the edge of the domain area. (The slow effect will diminish over time.)[time needed]
Estes casts an enhanced (enhanced) Moonlight Immersion on all friendly heroes nearby. In the next 8 seconds, "Moonlight Immersion" will be enhanced and Estes will continuously recover.

eudora.description: Eudora's skills inflict Superconductor on affected non-minion units for 5 seconds and can trigger additional effects against enemies affected by Superconductor.

Eudora casts Forked Lightning in a fan-shaped area, dealing (increased to 200% against minions) to enemies inside. When you hit targets affected by Superconductor. Eudora forms a chain of lightning with the target. gaining 40% movement speed while chaining for up to 1 second. The lightning chain expands over time and extra when it ends. If this hit succeeds, it reduces the skill's cooldown by 50%.

Eudora launches an orb of lightning at the targeted enemy, reducing their magic defense from 10 to 25 for 1.8 seconds, damaging and stunning them for 1 second. If the target is affected by Superconductor, the lightning orb reduces the magic defense of nearby enemies, deals AOE damage focused on the target, and stuns all nearby enemies.

Eudora fires a bolt of lightning at the target area, dealing damage to targets in the center. Then he hits targets off center and inflicts them. Whenever Thunder's Wrath hits a target affected by the Superconductor, it triggers an explosion centered on the Superconductor's target after a short delay, dealing damage.

fanny.description: During combat, Fanny deals 10-20% more damage to enemies hit (scales with flight speed [unknown speed]) and applies a stack of Prey Mark|mark (up to 2 stacks) to them with each attack. His subsequent skills on marked enemy heroes restore 8 energy per stack. Energy restoration is reduced [amount unknown] if it hits multiple enemy heroes in a short period of time. [duration unknown]
Fanny spins her blades, dealing damage to nearby enemies.

Fanny pulls a cable in the target direction which pulls her to the first obstacle encountered. She can cast this skill again within 2 seconds until her energy is depleted. Each successive cast reduces the energy cost of the skill by 2. Fanny automatically casts Tornado Strike when she hits an enemy in mid-air, as long as her energy is sufficient.
Fanny jumps on the targeted enemy hero or Creep with her blades, dealing damage. Each stack of the target's Prey Mark increases this damage by 30%.

faramis.description: Every 4 seconds, Faramis' next skill against enemy heroes and summoned items generates a Soul Fragment on the spot. Faramis can absorb the soul fragment to restore it and gain 2 additional magical powers (up to 40 stacks). Upon death, he consumes the absorbed Soul Fragments to reduce the respawn time, each reducing the time by 3% (up to 90%). Enemies that die around Faramis also have a chance [how much?] to drop Soul Fragments.

Faramis enters the Shadow state for 3 seconds, gaining 70% additional movement speed, 25 additional physical and magical defense, 20% reduction in the cooldown of this skill, and the ability to move around the field. Enemy heroes who come into contact with Faramis in this state receive a Nether Mark. Leaving the Shadow state, Faramis drags all marked enemy heroes towards him and distributes them. Use it again to exit the Shadow state early and drag marked enemies towards him. The absorption range of Soul Fragments is increased when this skill is active.

Faramis gathers Nether energy into a fan-shaped area, attacking enemies within. The energy will then split and bounce back to nearby enemies, dealing (will split up to 2 times on enemy hero hits and 1 time on non-enemy hero hits).

Faramis transforms his environment into the Nether Realm for 6 seconds, causing the affected allied hero (including himself) to enter the Ghost state and granting him +% increased HP and 50% increased movement speed for 1 second. When the Ghost state breaks, the hero will clear all debuffs and enter a brief resurrection state for 1 second. An allied hero's Ghost state ends when they leave the Void Realm.

floryn.description: The Dew Lantern will permanently increase Floryn's attributes by a small amount. After leaving combat for 5 seconds, Floryn can share the Flower of Hope with an allied hero (30 second cooldown), which will grant him each time he is healed by Floryn. Floryn will never sell the Lantern.
Floryn throws an energy seed at a targeted enemy, dealing damage. Healing Fruits will then appear and bounce to nearby allied heroes, restoring them.

Floryn projects a blob of energy in front of him that explodes when it hits an enemy, dealing damage to nearby enemies and stunning them for 0.5 seconds (and briefly revealing their positions). [time required]
Floryn resonates with Dew's power, healing all allied heroes 2x, no matter where they are. This effect also increases their Shield and HP Regeneration effects by 12% for 2 seconds.

franco.description: If no damage is taken within 5 seconds, Franco gains 10% movement speed, recovers 1% maximum HP per second, and begins accumulating Wasteland Force|e (up to 10 stacks). Franco will consume all stacks of Wasteland Force during his next skill to increase the skill's damage by up to 150%.
Franco throws an iron hook in the target direction. The hook will snag the first enemy unit hit, dragging it towards Franco.
Franco goes on a rampage, dealing physical damage equal to 300-450 plus 4% of his maximum HP to nearby enemies and Slowing them by 70% for 1.5 seconds.
Franco suppresses the targeted enemy hero for 1.8 seconds and hits them 6 times for the duration, dealing damage each time.

fredrinn.description: Fredrinn gains 1 combo point that lasts for 5 seconds each time his skill hits a non-minion enemy, up to 4 combo points. His Ultimate costs different numbers of combo points depending on different skill levels. Fredrinn stores 100% of the damage he receives as crystal energy | E, which decays after 5 seconds at a rate of 10% maximum HP per second. Fredrinn can convert stored Crystal Energy|E into HP for 20% of his damage dealt (10% for damage dealt to minions). Gaining a combo point resets the timer.

Fredrinn thrusts his sword in the targeted direction, dealing damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 30% for 2 seconds. His next basic attack gains additional attack range and deals. [Skill duration required] This skill deals 200% damage to non-hero enemies.
Fredrinn dashes in the target direction, dealing to the first non-minion enemy hit. Its next basic attack knocks the target into the air for 0.3 seconds. [duration of skill required]

Fredrinn deals 210 (+100% bonus physical attack) physical damage to nearby enemies and taunts them for 1 second. Striking a non-minion enemy grants Fredrinn 25 Physical and Spell Defense for 3 seconds and reduces the cooldowns of Piercing Strike and Courageous Assault by 75%. This skill costs 1 combo point.

Fredrinn slams his sword in the target direction (this skill can only be interrupted by Suppression), dealing 600 plus 21% of his crystal energy as physical damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area after a short delay. Enemies in the center of the area take 175% damage. This skill doubles the conversion rate based on damage dealt to enemy heroes, crystal energy stored in HP. This skill costs 3 combo points.

freya.description: Freya gains 1 holy orb with each basic attack (up to 6 holy orbs). Consuming 1 Holy Orb grants Freya 100% attack speed for her next basic attack (max 6 stacks). Holy orbs gradually recover outside of combat.
Freya jumps towards the target area and slams the ground with her shield, gaining and dealing damage to enemies inside while knocking them into the air for 0.4 seconds.
Freya charges forward and strikes, dealing and slowing enemies by 30% for 0.5 seconds. This skill has no base cooldown but consumes 2 Holy Orbs per cast. This skill deals 50% damage to creeps.

Freya selects a target area and dives like a Valkyrie (gaining control immunity and 50% damage reduction), dealing and slowing enemies in her path and at the landing point by 40% for 2 seconds. Upon landing, Freya enters the Valkyrie state for 12 seconds, during which her basic attacks deal an additional 30-60 damage (additional damage cannot be critical) and she recovers per basic attack, and her basic attacks deal area damage.

gatotkaca.description: Gatotkaca gains [1] Physical Defense equal to 2% of his HP lost (up to 100). For every 300 damage suffered (calculated before damage reduction), he gains 5 Rage (up to 100). When he reaches above 25 Rage, Gatotkaca's next basic attack becomes enhanced, consuming all of his Rage to deal additional magic damage and recover. Additional damage depends on his rage, level and magic power.
Gatotkaca slams the ground, creating a broken area in the target direction while dealing damage to enemies inside. Enemies in the Broken Zone will take a second and be slowed by 30%.

Gatotkaca begins channeling, then sprints in the target direction with a battle cry, forcing enemies in the path to attack and deal damage to him for 1.5 seconds. The sprint distance changes with channel time. Canceling the skill reduces the remaining cooldown by 50%.

Gatotkaca jumps towards the target location, dealing damage to nearby enemies and knocking them into the air for 1 second. Enemies near the center of the area will be knocked into the air for a longer duration, while enemies on the fringes will be pulled towards the center. The camera will move with the skill indicator but will not grant additional sight.

gloo.description: Enemies gain a stack of Sticky whenever they are hit by Gloo's skills, reducing their movement speed by 4% for 6 seconds. Stacks up to 5. Each stack of Sticky on an enemy reduces damage dealt to Gloo by 4%.

Gloo reaches out and slams the ground, dealing damage to the enemy. At the end, there is still a Goo which explodes after 3 seconds to deal with nearby enemies and immobilize them for 1 second. If Gloo touches the Goo, it will immediately explode, reset the skill cooldown, and heal Gloo for 2.5-5% of maximum HP if the explosion hits an enemy (double if it hits an enemy hero).

Gloo splits into Goos, dealing damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area and rooting them for 0.5 seconds. When split, Gloo gains 10% movement speed and deals damage every 0.25 seconds to enemies it hits, for 4 seconds. If this skill hits a Goo, Gloo will charge to merge with it, dragging enemies in its path in the same direction for a certain distance.

Unlocked when an enemy hero has full Sticky stacks. Gloo attaches to the targeted enemy hero for up to 9 seconds, recovering 25-30% of their maximum HP. For the duration, its basic attacks are converted to dealing damage, and it transfers 80% of the damage it receives (excluding turret damage) to its host. If the target dies while attached, the cooldown of this skill is reduced to 5 seconds.

gord.description: After Gord hits an enemy 4 times with basic attacks or skills in a short period of time, the next attack on the target will deal an additional attack and slow them by 20% for 1 second (the slow effect stacks up to 2 times).

Gord summons a mystical orb that bounces in the target direction and explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing damage to enemies in the area, while stunning them and revealing their location for 1 second.
Gord creates an energy field in the target area, dealing damage every 0.3 seconds to enemies inside (up to 13 times).
Gord releases a beam of energy in the target direction, damaging enemies hit every 0.2 seconds (up to 16 times). The beam direction can be adjusted using the joystick.

granger.description: Granger's unique demon hunting pistol and cannon are powered by demonic energy. Both of his weapons have a fixed energy limit of 800. His weapon restores 8% energy per second while his cannon restores 2% energy per second. Each Minion/Creep kill will permanently increase the energy cap of Granger's Pistol and Cannon by 6/6, and instantly restore their energy by 5%/5%, respectively. Each kill or assist of an enemy hero will permanently increase their energy cap by 12 and instantly restore 10% energy. Each gain of 1% Granger CD reduction is converted into 2 physical attacks. Demonic energy cost is not affected by energy cost reductions.

Granger quickly fires 6 shots from her weapon, each shot dealing and consuming 70 weapon energy. The last ball is guaranteed at the Crit. Each bullet deals 70 additional damage to Creeps and Minions. While shooting, Granger's movement speed is increased by 15%. Granger stops shooting when he runs out of energy or when the skill is cast again. Rhapsody has a brief cooldown and can be cast once its Gun Energy exceeds 420.

Granger uses her Demon Hunter agility to dash in the target direction, instantly restoring 15-25% energy to her weapon. Rondo can be cast while channeling Rhapsody. Each time Rhapsody hits an enemy, Rondo's cooldown is reduced by 0.5 seconds.

Granger fires her cannon in the targeted direction, dealing damage to the first enemy Hero hit as well as other targets within the blast radius. Targets hit will be slowed and revealed for a brief duration. Granger can roll in the direction of the joystick after each shot. Death Sonata can be cast while drawing Rhapsody. Death Sonata has a brief cooldown and consumes 250 units of Granger Cannon energy per shot.

grock.description: Grock gains a shield equal to 10% of his maximum HP and allows the next basic attack to deal an amount equal to % of the target's maximum HP (capped against non-hero units). This effect has a cooldown of 18 to 12 seconds (decreases with level), which decreases by 200% near terrain. Grock's skills cannot be interrupted and gain % additional physical defense while the shield is active.

Grock attacks with massive force and deals. Enemies with obstacles behind them are knocked against the obstacle, launched into the air, and take an additional % of their maximum HP (capped against non-hero units). If there are no obstacles behind, enemies are only slightly pushed back.
After a brief delay, Grock summons a stone wall in the target area, dealing and knocking enemies towards him. Reuse: Cancel the wall early.

Grock charges forward, dealing damage to enemies in his path. When it hits the ground, it immediately stops and unleashes a massive explosion that knocks nearby enemies into the air for 1 second and deals damage to them. If this skill does not hit the field, 50% of its cooldown is refunded.

guinevere.description: Guinevere deals 25% more damage to aerial enemies. Guinevere manages her basic attacks and accumulates super magic every time she deals damage. When fully charged, her next basic attack becomes guided, dealing hits and regenerating. Enemies hit by Guinevere's Improved Basic Attack, Energy Wave, or Space Migration are marked for 5 seconds. Those with 3 marks will be knocked into the air when hit by her Violet Requiem.

Guinevere releases an orb of energy in the targeted direction, dealing damage to the first enemy hit and slowing them by 25% for 1.2 seconds. Successfully hitting an enemy reduces all skill cooldowns by 1 second.

Guinevere jumps towards the target location, inflicting [stunning enemies there for 1 second]. Enemy Heroes and Creeps hit will be knocked into the air for 1 second and take additional magic damage. After casting, Guinevere can reactivate the skill in 5 seconds to blink towards the target direction [while invisible for 0.5 seconds] and leave an illusion behind. If the illusion takes damage, it restores Guinevere's Super Magic and will explode over 1.5 seconds, dealing damage to nearby enemies.

Guinevere creates a force field around herself [for 2 seconds], attacking nearby enemies 11 times over 2 seconds, dealing total damage. If the hit enemy is already in the air, they will be knocked into the air again, up to 8 additional times. Guinevere is immune to crowd control when casting this skill.

gusion.description: Each skill cast adds a rune to Gusion's dagger (cumulative up to 4 times). Each stack enhances Gusion's next basic attack to deal additional damage equal to 3% of the target's maximum HP and restore itself.

Gusion throws a dagger in the target direction, dealing the first enemy hit and marking them. Use again|e}: Gusion moves behind the marked enemy and deals damage to them. This skill cannot be interrupted while Gusion is moving behind the marked enemy.

Gusion launches a volley of [five] daggers in the targeted direction, each dealing damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 6% for 2 seconds (when hit by multiple daggers, the slow effect can stack up to 30%). Reuse:|e Gusion recalls daggers, each dealing damage to enemies in its path.

Gusion dashes to the target location, resetting the cooldown of Sword Spike and Shadowblade Slaughter. If Shadowblade Slaugther was cast once before the reset, Gusion can cast five more daggers during his next Shadowblade Slaughter, and recall a total of ten daggers afterward. Reuse:|e Gusion dashes a short distance to the target location.

hanabi.description: Hanabi's basic attacks and skills will launch Petal Blades after hitting a target, bouncing up to 4 times to nearby enemies (the first bounce deals 40% damage, and subsequent bounces deal 85% of the previous damage). Rebounds from his basic attacks inherit part of the attack effects.

Passive:|e The Scarlet Shadow's Secret Ninjutsu makes Hanabi immune to control effects while she has a shield from any source. Active:|e Hanabi gains one for 5 seconds. When the shield is active, Hanabi gains 20% movement speed, 25% attack speed, and 20% of damage dealt will also be added to this shield (only 10% of damage dealt to non-hero units). The shield cannot exceed 50% of Hanabi's max HP.

Hanabi fires Kunai energy in the targeted direction, dealing damage to enemies along the way and reducing their movement speed by 60% for 1 second. Enemy units hit will also be marked, allowing the next bounce damage from Hanabi's basic attacks to deal them without damage decay.

Hanabi casts Higanbana in the targeted direction, dealing the first enemy Hero hit and immobilizing them for 0.8 seconds. After 1 second, Higanbana will bloom at the location of the first hit, dealing damage to nearby enemies. Subsequent hits on the same target reduce damage by 20%.

hanzo.description: Damage dealt by Hanzo's basic attacks and skills inflicts a charge of Dark Ninjutsu on the target, up to 5 charges. Ninjutsu Demon Feast can only be cast on targets with full stacks of Dark Ninjutsu.

This skill can only be used on targets with maximum Dark Ninjutsu stacks. When targeting a creep, Hanzo will immediately devour it and digest it over a period of time to recover 20% HP. When targeting the Turtle, Lord, or enemy Heroes, it deals damage, recovers 10-20% HP, and reduces the cooldown of this skill by 60%.

Hanzo dashes in the target direction, leaving a dark mist in front of him that deals to enemies in the area every 0.5 seconds, up to 5 times (this damage counts as base attack damage but cannot critically hit). The dark mist slows enemies in the area by 40% and grants Hanzo 20% movement speed.

Hanzo charges into battle as Hanekage, consuming 170 energy per second. He gains 20 Energy when a non-hero unit dies nearby and 200 Energy when it is a hero. He gains 15 Energy when he attacks a hero, and 45 Energy when he attacks the Turtle or the Lord. When the energy is exhausted, Hanzo's body will slowly be pulled towards Hanekage's position. In Hanekage form, Hanzo's body is invincible and Hanekage ignores obstacles and gains 50% movement speed and 30% attack speed. Use Again or Upon Death: Hanekage returns to Hanzo's body, recovering 16% and becoming untargetable upon return. If Hanekage is killed, Hanzo will be slowed by 50% and revealed for 6 seconds.

Damage dealt by Hanzo's basic attacks and skills inflicts a charge of Dark Ninjutsu on the target, up to 5 charges. Ninjutsu: Demon Feast can only be cast on targets with full charges of Dark Ninjutsu.

Hanekage dashes at an enemy hero, dealing 300 (+60% bonus physical attack) physical damage to the target after a brief delay. Each stack of Dark Ninjutsu on the target increases this damage by 20%. When the target has maximum Dark Ninjutsu stacks, it deals additional damage equal to 15 (+2% additional Physical Attack)% of the target's maximum HP (ignoring 30% of the target's Physical Defense) and recovers 20% of Hanzo's maximum HP. This skill can be cast on the Turtle or the Lord (deals up to 1000 damage).

Hanekage dashes in the target direction, knocking enemies in his path into the air for 0.4 sec and dealing 405 (+45% bonus Physical Attack) physical damage (recovers 200 energy if he hits an enemy hero), leaving a dark mist in the area he passes through. The mist deals 135 (+45% bonus physical attack) physical damage to enemies in the area every 0.5 sec (up to 4 times). It also slows enemies in the area by 40%. This damage is considered basic attack damage, but cannot be critical.
Hanekage returns to Hanzo's body and leaves the Hanekage form.

harith.description: Harith takes a glimpse of his key. He gains 7% hybrid lifesteal for each nearby enemy hero, stacking up to 35%.

Harith creates a ghost of himself in a distant location. Harith and his ghost will then cast Synchro Fission at each other, dealing to all enemy units in the path. When the 2 energy waves collide, an explosion occurs, affecting all enemies in the explosion area.

Harith rushes towards the target direction. When he arrives, he steals magic power from enemy heroes, generates a shield that at least absorbs damage, and enhances his next basic attack. Harith's improved basic attack deals and slows enemies by 40%. Hitting an enemy with Harith's Improved Basic Attack reduces the cooldown of Chrono Dash by 3 seconds.

Harith uses his key to summon the Zaman Force. When the Multidimensional Rift appears, Chrono Dash's cooldown is reduced by 4 seconds. The Rift initially slows enemy Heroes in the area by 70% and will then continually slow enemy Heroes by 35%. If Harith comes into contact with the rift using Chrono Dash, he will absorb the energy inside and reduce the cooldown of Synchro Fission by 1 second and Chrono Dash by 3 seconds. Harith gains 15% resilience while on the Rift.

harley.description: Harley's magic mastery allows her basic attack to deal 60 (+50% of total physical attack)(+60% of total magic power) magic damage. His attacks reduce the enemy's Magic Defense by 2 for 3 seconds when hit (up to 10 stacks).

Harley throws 3-5 waves of cards in the target direction, each dealing 130-210 (+25% total Magic Power) magic damage to the first enemy hit and granting them 10% more Attack Speed ​​for 3 seconds afterward (up to 5-10 stacks). Enemies hit more than 3 times will take less damage from subsequent hits.

Harley blinks in the direction shown, leaving a magic hat in its place, increasing her movement speed by 30% for 2 seconds. Reuse: Use again within 4 seconds to return to where the hat is and lose the speed boost.

Harley throws a ring of magic fire at the targeted enemy hero (can be blocked by other heroes), dealing 200-400 (+60% total magic power) magic damage and Slowing them by 40% for 1.5 seconds. The magic ring stays around the enemy for 4 seconds, during which Harley can hit the magic ring to damage the enemy with her skills. The magic ring will explode at the end of the duration, dealing 100-200 (+30% total magic power) plus 50% of the damage taken by the enemy during the duration as magic damage.

hayabusa.description: Hayabusa's attacks apply a charge of Shadow Mark|mark to the hit (up to 4 charges). Each stack lasts 6 seconds and increases Hayabusa's damage to the enemy by 5%.

Hayabusa throws three shurikens in the target direction, each dealing damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 35% for 2 seconds. Enemies hit by multiple shurikens only take 30% damage after the first hit. Hayabusa restores 10 energy for each non-minion enemy hit. Passive:|e Hayabusa permanently gains 3% to 18% Spell Vamp.

Hayabusa rushes in the target direction and releases four ghosts that move in different directions. The ghosts will either stay at the end of their path or attach to the first enemy hero hit, damaging them and slowing them by 40% for 2 seconds. Hayabusa will immediately stop if he hits an enemy hero while sprinting. Reuse:|e Hayabusa teleports to a ghost's location and reduces the cooldown of Ninjutsu Phantom Shuriken by 1 second. If the ghost is attached to an enemy hero, it also deals with the enemy.

Hayabusa blends into the shadows and launches 6 single-target attacks at enemies in the area, each dealing damage. Attacks prioritize enemies with Shadow Mark|mark and each will consume a mark to deal additional physical damage. Do not apply the shadow mark.

helcurt.description: Helcurt remains in the Prowler|e state until spotted by the enemy team, gaining 15% additional movement speed and continually regenerating his HP if he has dealt no damage. He gains 50% more Attack Speed ​​and 50% more Movement Speed ​​(decreasing over time) for 4 seconds after being spotted and exits the Prowler|e state 0.75 seconds later. Any hero killed after being hit by Helcurt leaves a dark fog that explodes and spreads with a 10 second cooldown. Helcurt hides in the dark fog.

Passive: When Helcurt is in the Prowler state, the skill terrifies enemy heroes hit and its cooldown decreases 3 times faster. Active: Helcurt flashes to the target location and deals damage to enemies in the area, reducing their movement speed by 60% for 0.75 sec.

Passive:|e Helcurt gains a Deadly Stinger every 1.5 sec spent in the Prowler|e state or with each basic attack. Up to 5 stingers can be stored. Active:|e Helcurt pulls all Deadly Stinger forward, dealing each to enemies (minons and Creeps only take 70% damage). Deadly Stinger counts as a basic attack, but it cannot crit.

Helcurt invokes Black Night, reducing the sight range of all enemies and causing them to lose sight of their allies for 3 seconds. During Dark Night|E, Helcurt gains 40% movement speed. Black Night makes it easier for Helcurt to leave enemies' sight range.

hilda.description: Hilda recovers 2% HP per second while in the bush. Entering a bush enhances his next basic attack, which deals damage to the target, reduces the target's movement speed by 40%, and deals damage to enemies behind the target. After using the Improved Basic Attack, this effect goes into a 6 second cooldown. Hilda's basic attack and skills apply a mark of desert on a hit, which lasts up to 4 seconds and stacks up to 6. Each stack reduces the enemy hero's physical defense and magic defense by 3%.
Hilda gains 60% movement speed for 3 seconds and receives a shield that absorbs damage equal to 10% of maximum HP for 3 seconds.

Hilda locks onto an enemy target and deals damage to them each time. The skill can be released a maximum of 3 times. The 2nd attack will deal damage to the surroundings of the target, and the 3rd attack will temporarily knock back the target and surrounding enemies.

Hilda [jumps forward and] launches a powerful attack at the target enemy, damaging and stunning them for 0.2 seconds. Nearby enemies also take 60% damage. Each stack of Wilderness Mark allows Power of Wildness to deal 2.5% of the target's maximum HP as additional damage. At maximum stacks, Power of Wildness deals 20% of the target's maximum HP as additional damage.

hirara.description: Hirara only has two skills, representing her two weapons: Meisen-e and Kaerazu. Drag one skill onto another to initiate a combo skill. Hirara has 2 Purple Energy / Death. Casting a combo skill consumes 1 purple/death energy. Energy recovery time is the same as Meisen-e's cooldown. Energy consumption interrupts the recovery process. Hirara only deals 30 (+4*hero level)% damage to minions.
Hirara rides the waves using Meisen-e, performing two joystick dashes (the first dash goes in the direction facing her). She takes care of affected enemies.

Hirara uses Kaerazu to release the Crimson Maple, dealing damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area. After a short delay, it deals damage again to the target location, dealing 2 times Crimson Maple's initial damage.

Hirara only has two skills, representing her two weapons: Meisen-e and Kaerazu. Drag one skill onto another to initiate a combo skill. Hirara has 2 Purple Energy / Death. Casting a combo skill consumes 1 purple/death energy. Energy recovery time is the same as Meisen-e's cooldown. Energy consumption interrupts the recovery process. Hirara only deals 30 (+4*hero level)% damage to minions.

Hirara enhances Kaerazu with the power of Meisen-e to launch a combo skill. She becomes untargetable and immobilized for 1 second maximum. After 0.6 sec, she deals 3x the damage of Crimson Maple, and can then throw Meisen-e's second joystick to end these states early.

Hirara enhances Meisen-e with Kaerazu's power to launch a combo skill. After throwing Meisen-e's first joystick, she spins, dealing 2.5 times the damage of Crimson Maple and rooting enemies for 0.8 seconds.

hylos.description: Hylos gains 1.5 additional Max HP for each additional 1 Max Mana he possesses. When he runs out of mana, Hylos can use his HP to cast skills.

Hylos gains 50% movement speed and allows his next basic attack within 3 seconds to damage, knock back, and stun the target for 1 second. The bonus movement speed decreases quickly over time and ends after the next basic attack.

Hylos unleashes the Ring of Punishment|E, dealing damage to nearby enemies per second while slowing them by 4-6% and reducing their attack speed by 7.5-15% for 2.5 seconds (up to 8 stacks). Each stack also increases the damage dealt to the enemy by the Ring of Punishment by 5-20%. The Ring of Punishment consumes 30 to 150 Mana per second while active. Reuse|e; Hylos cancels the Ring of Punishment.

Hylos creates a huge path in the targeted direction, reducing enemies' movement by 75% for 1 second. The course lasts 6 seconds. While on the path, Hylos gains slow immunity and recovers 3% of his max HP} per second. Allied heroes moving along the path gain 60% additional movement speed, while enemy heroes on the path will be slowed by 25%.

irithel.description: Irithel and Leo's impeccable teamwork allows him to shoot on the move. Each basic attack will fire 2 crossbow bolts (but takes longer to reload) which deal per bolt (inherits part [55%] of attack effects). The move will build Jungle Heart, up to a maximum of 10 units, and cause the next basic attack to trigger 1 additional bolt(s).
Irithel launches a volley of arrows at the target area, damaging enemies within and reducing their physical defense by 15 to 40 for 3 seconds.
Leo lets out a piercing roar, dealing damage to nearby enemies and Slowing them by 40% for 2 seconds.

Irithel orders Leo to jump in the target direction and boosts his crossbow for 10 seconds. During this duration, she gains 30 additional movement speed and her basic attacks fire enhanced crossbow bolts, damaging the target and nearby units. Jungle Heart also stacks faster over the duration. [amount unknown]

ixia.description: Ixia's basic attacks and skills apply a stack of Starlium Charge|e to enemies when hit. When Ixia performs a basic attack on an enemy with two stacks of Starlium Charge, the attack will consume the charges and be replaced with Siphon Starlium|e, dealing a bonus to the target. Ixia recovers HP equal to the damage dealt by Siphon Starlium (only % against non-hero units). Siphon Starlium can trigger on any enemies in front of Ixia that are within range of its basic attack, but it cannot deal a critical hit. Ixia's basic attacks cannot trigger lifesteal.

Ixia fires 2 Starlium-charged energy beams along the ground in the target direction, dealing damage to enemies in a rectangular area and slowing enemy Heroes by 40%. When hitting an enemy hero, Ixia also gains 40% movement speed for 3 seconds. Enemies hit by both beams will take double damage.

Ixia launches a Starlium energy canister in the target direction, knocking back nearby enemies and pulling enemies within range towards the midline after a short delay (approximately 0.5 seconds) and damaging them.

Ixia disassembles her weapon into 6 smaller weapons and enters the Barrage state for 4 seconds. In this state, Ixia's basic attacks and skills can hit enemies in a large fan-shaped area, but not outside. Ixia's basic attacks can hit up to 6 enemy units (prioritizing heroes), and Siphon Starlium will fire simultaneously with her normal basic attacks.

jawhead.description: Jawhead's attacks apply a charge of Mecha Suppression on impact (up to 10 charges). Each stack lasts 3 seconds and increases the damage of Jawhead's basic attacks on the enemy by 8%.
Jawhead launches up to 12 missiles at random nearby enemies for 5 seconds, with each missile dealing damage to the enemy hit.

Jawhead gains 30% movement speed and one for S seconds. Reuse:|e Jawhead knocks the nearest unit (prioritizing Heroes) towards the target location, dealing damage to enemies in the area and stunning them for 0.5 seconds. Can be used on allied heroes and they will not take damage.

Jawhead charges at the targeted enemy hero, inflicting and briefly stunning them. [duration unknown] Enemies around the target are knocked back and deal the same amount of damage. Jawhead is immune to control effects while charging.

johnson.description: When Johnson's HP drops below 30%, he gains one for 10 seconds. Cooldown: 100.0 seconds.
Johnson throws his wrench towards the target location, dealing damage to enemies in his path. Enemies around the landing point are stunned for 0.8 seconds.

Johnson raises his shield, continuously dealing damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area in the target direction and slowing them by 20%. Each instance of damage also increases the enemy's subsequent damage caused by the skill by 15% (up to 45%). This damage is increased by 60% against creeps. Johnson can perform basic attacks and skills for the duration of the spell.

Johnson transforms into a car and begins to speed up over time. An allied hero can use Hop In|e near Johnson to board the car (only one allied hero can ride with Johnson). The car will explode when hitting a hero or enemy obstacle, dealing damage to nearby enemies. stunning them for 0.5 to 1 second (scales with the speed of the car before impact), [unknown speed] and creating an electrified zone at the location. The area continually deals and slows enemies in it. While in a car, press Brake to stop immediately or hold Nitrous to continuously gain speed for up to 5 seconds. Johnson's location will be revealed to the enemy for 3 seconds when casting this skill. Passive:|e Johnson's physical defense is increased by 10% to 30%.

joy.description: Joy becomes Angry!|E whenever her skill hits a non-minion enemy, dealing 100 magic damage and increasing her movement speed by 60% which decreases over 4 seconds (hitting the Leonin Crystal|E will also grant the movement speed effect). This effect has a cooldown of 4 seconds for each target. Joy's basic attack will deal.

Joy summons a Leonin Crystal|E to the target location, dealing damage to nearby enemies and slowing them by 30% for 1 second. The Leonine Crystal lasts 2 seconds and can be used as a springboard for its second skill, Meow, Rhythm of Joy!.

Joy dashes in the target direction, dealing damage to enemies in her path. Hitting an enemy or the Leonin Crystal|E allows Joy to cast this skill again in 0.8 seconds and gain 1 Beat Energy. Casting this skill on beat increases the skill's damage by 100% and grants a shield that lasts for 3 seconds. This skill can be cast up to 4 times in a row.

Joy increases her physical and magical defense and gains 30% movement speed. Over the next 4 seconds, it pulses 8 times, each time damaging nearby enemies. Each Meow, Rhythm of Joy!|E cast on the rhythm increases the damage of this skill by 40%. If a perfect rhythm is achieved by hitting each beat with Meow, Rhythm of Joy!|E, Joy also gains 40% Spell Vamp while this skill is active. This skill is unlocked when Joy acquires Beat Energy|E. Casting this skill with 3 Beat Energy|E will remove all debuffs from Joy and make her immune to slow effects while this skill is active.

julian.description: After casting two different skills, Julian upgrades his third skill. Casting the upgraded skill makes all his skills work with a cooldown of 9 to 6 seconds (decreases with his level. After casting a skill, his basic attacks in the next 5 seconds to deal and pull the target towards him. Casting another skill extends the duration. Julian gains 15% additional hybrid lifesteal for 5 seconds every time he hits an enemy hero with his skills (up to 3 charges).
Julian throws a flying scythe in the targeted direction, dealing damage to enemies along the way and slowing them by 30% for 1 second. The scythe disappears when hitting a non-minion enemy.
Julian summons a flying sword and rushes in the target direction, dealing damage to enemies along the way.
Julian throws chains at the target location, dealing 300 (+100% total Magic Power) magic damage to enemies hit after a short delay and Rooting them for 1.2 seconds.

After casting two different skills, Julian upgrades his third skill. Casting the upgraded skill causes all of his skills to have a cooldown of 9 to 6 seconds (decreases with his level). After casting any skill, his basic attacks for the next 2 seconds will deal 100 (+100% of total physical attack) (+100% of total magic power) magic damage and pull the target towards him (deals 85% damage to Creeps). Casting another skill extends the duration. Julian gains 15% additional Hybrid Lifesteal for 5 seconds each time he hits an enemy Hero with his skills (up to 3 stacks).

Julian throws enhanced scythes in the targeted direction, dealing 420 (+140% total magic power) magic damage to enemies along the way and slowing them by 50% for 1 second. When hitting a non-minion enemy or reaching maximum distance, scythes continue to fly at a slower speed, dealing 80 (+30% total magic power) magic damage every 0.3 sec to nearby enemies (up to 8 times).

Julian summons a large number of flying swords and rushes in the target direction, dealing 75 (+15% total magic power) magic damage every 0.1 sec to enemies along the way (up to 9 times). Julian is untargetable and invisible while running.

Julian throws chains at the target location, dealing 40 (+10% total magic power) magic damage every 0.2 sec to enemies hit and Slowing them by 30%. Enemies that are still in the area at the end of the skill's duration will take 250 (+100% total Magic Power) additional Magic Damage and be knocked into the air for 0.8 seconds.

kadita.description: Kadita gains Ocean's Blessing every 30 seconds. The blessing triggers when she takes damage from enemy heroes and lasts for 4 seconds, allowing her to recover 65% of lost HP for the next duration.

Kadita summons an ocean wave to move in the target direction and back, dealing damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 30%. While inside the wave, she gains control immunity and 50% damage reduction. This skill can traverse obstacles and terrain. Use again: Kadita leaves the wave without interrupting the wave's movement.

After a short delay, Kadita summons an ocean wave that erupts at the target location, dealing damage to enemies hit and knocking them into the air for 1 second. Kadita can cast this skill during Ocean Ode to summon an ocean wave beneath her with a shorter eruption delay.

Kadita dives into the ground and sends ocean waves in all directions, each damaging enemies hit and slowing them by 30%. Enemies hit by multiple waves take increased damage. After a short period, the waves return to Kadita, each dealing damage to enemies hit. When diving underground, Kadita cannot be interrupted (except Suppression). While underground, Kadita becomes untargetable and gains 60% movement speed.

kagura.description: Upon collecting the Seimei Umbrella, Kagura gains one, stuns nearby enemies for 0.5 seconds and slows them by 60% for 1 second. Cooldown 4.5 seconds.

Kagura sends the Seimei Umbrella to the target location, dealing damage to enemies in its path and slowing them by 60% for 0.5 seconds. The Umbrella will automatically return to Kagura when she is too far away. This skill deals 130% damage to non-hero enemies.
Kagura removes all debuffs on her and rushes in the target direction, while leaving the Seimei Umbrella behind.
Kagura summons the power of the Seimei Umbrella, dealing damage to nearby enemies, knocking them back, and slowing them by 60% for 0.5 seconds.
After collecting the Seimei Umbrella, Kagura gains a shield of 450 (+80% total magic power), stuns nearby enemies for 0.5 seconds, and slows them by 60% for 1 second. Cooldown: 4.5s.

Kagura sends the Seimei Umbrella to the target location, dealing 365 (+105% total Magic Power) magic damage to enemies in its path and Slowing them by 60% for 0.5 seconds. The Umbrella will automatically return to Kagura when she is too far away. This skill deals 130% damage to non-hero enemies.
Kagura teleports to the location of the Seimei Umbrella and collects it, dealing 300 (+90% total magic power) magic damage to nearby enemies.

Kagura resets the cooldown of Seimei Umbrella Open, dealing 235 (+60% total Magic Power) magic damage to enemies around the Seimei Umbrella and Slowing them by 60%. After 1.5 seconds, enemy heroes around the umbrella are pulled towards the center and take 480 (+155% total magic power) magic damage.

kaja.description: Kaja's skill damage applies a paralysis effect to enemy units, briefly slowing heroes or summoned units and reducing their damage by 8% for 5 seconds.
Kaja summons a ring of Primal Lightning that expands and returns to him. The enemies strike and return to Kaja. Healing from subsequent hits is reduced to 33%.

Kaja dashes towards the target area, gaining control immunity while sprinting. Upon arrival, it deals damage, knocks back and stuns nearby enemies for 0.5 seconds, then enters the Flying state. The Soaring state lasts 6.6 seconds. During this time, he ignores obstacles and gains 15% movement speed, but his turn radius is restricted. He can use basic attacks while moving, dealing (+2% of the target's maximum HP) to surrounding enemies. Upon entering the Soaring state, the cooldown of Soaring Wings 2 is reduced to 4 seconds (unaffected by cooldown reduction). Hitting a Hero or Creep extends the Soaring state by 2.6 seconds.

Kaja throws a Primal Lightning Laso at the target area. After a 0.5 second delay, all enemy heroes remaining in the area are captured and trapped for 2.5 seconds. When active, Kaja can drag the lasso, reducing its radius and dragging enemies to the limit with it (not interrupting their skills).

kalea.description: After casting a skill, Kalea creates an area of ​​water on the ground. When Kalea casts a skill in this area, she will absorb it to enhance her next three basic attacks with different effects: First Basic Attack: Kalea rushes towards the target and deals damage. Second Basic Attack: Kalea unleashes a flurry of attacks, dealing and recovering HP to herself and the lowest HP nearby ally. Third Basic Attack: Kalea uses her tail to strike the area around her target, inflicting and creating a new area of ​​water. Improved basic attacks are not affected by attack speed.
Kalea slams her fist into the ground, creating a wave that deals damage to nearby enemies and slows them by 40% for 1.5 seconds.

Kalea charges forward and strikes the first enemy hero she encounters, knocking them into the air for 0.6 seconds while dealing with them. If she collides with an obstacle or touches the edge of a water area while charging, Kalea will jump into the air. Cast the skill again to strike a target location, dealing and knocking enemies into the air for 0.6 seconds.
Kalea grabs an enemy hero with its tail and swipes it towards the joystick, dealing damage to the target and nearby enemies.

karina.description: Karina's third consecutive attack on the same enemy deals additional true damage equal to over 50% of her lost HP (up to 2000 true damage against creeps). If the target is an enemy hero, Karina's non-ultimate skill cooldowns are reduced by 1.5 seconds.

Karina enters the Blade Dance state for 3.5 seconds, during which she gains 45% additional movement speed, blocks all incoming basic attacks, and reflects back at the attacker (the damage reflection effect has a 0.4 second cooldown). Karina's basic attack for the duration slows the target by 45% for 1 second and guarantees a critical hit. Casting the Improved Basic Attack or Shadow Assault ends the Blade Dance state prematurely.
Karina launches a spinning attack that deals damage to nearby enemies.

Karina rushes to the targeted enemy hero, inflicts and applies a Shadow Mark on them, and leaves a Shadow Form behind. Shadow Mark and Shadow Form both last 5 seconds. If the enemy dies during the duration, the cooldown of this skill is reset. Reuse:|e Karina rushes towards the shadow form|e's location, dealing damage to enemies along the way.

karrie.description: Karrie's basic attacks and skills apply a stack of Lightwheel Mark on a hit. Once a target has 5 stacks of Light Wheel Marks, the marks will transform into a Light Wheel, dealing true damage equal to 6% - 8% of the target's maximum HP (only up to 300 damage against Creeps).

Karrie releases a surging sphere of energy in the targeted direction, dealing damage to enemies in its path. The sphere will stop as soon as it hits an enemy hero or reaches its maximum movement distance, continuously dealing damage to nearby enemies and Slowing them by 80% for 1 second.

Karrie dashes in the target direction while throwing a Lightwheel at the nearest enemy, dealing and applying a stack of Lightwheel Mark. When in Dual Wield state, Karrie launches two light wheels instead.

Karrie enters the Dual Wield state for 6 sec, during which she gains 20% movement speed and launches two Light Wheels with each basic attack, each dealing 50-70% of basic attack damage and inheriting a portion of attack effects.

khaleed.description: Khaleed builds up desert power as he moves. Once Desert Power is fully charged, it will slide across the sand, increasing movement speed by 35%, performing its next basic attack on the target (cannot deal a critical hit), and reducing the target's movement speed by 40% for 1.5 seconds.
Khaleed swings his scimitar, dealing damage to enemies in the area and drawing them towards him. This skill can be used up to 3 times in a row. This skill deals 50-75% damage to minions and Creeps.

Khaleed protects himself with the Power of Quicksand, restoring 60-135 plus 5-10% of his lost HP and 10 Desert Power every 0.5 seconds, reducing damage taken by 35-50% for up to 4 seconds. When channeling, quicksand appears under his feet, slowing the enemy by 60%. This skill is a targeted throw. Any further checks will interrupt this skill.

Khaleed rides the sandstorm and charges towards a designated location, dealing damage to enemies along the way and knocking them towards his destination. Khaleed is immune to control effects during this process. Upon reaching the destination, Khaleed will crush the ground, dealing damage to enemies in the area and stunning them for 1 second, and fully charge his Desert Power.

khufra.description: Khufra activates the spell left by Esmeralda every 12 seconds, enhancing her next basic attack. Improved Basic Attack gains additional attack range [Cast Range: 4.9] and deals []. Also slows the target by 30% for 1.5 seconds and heals Khufra for 8% of her maximum HP on a hit. Each time Khufra applies a control effect to an enemy hero with her skill, the cooldown of Spell Curse is reduced by 4 seconds.

Khufra pulls the bandage on her arms to launch herself in the specified direction, dealing 50-100 plus 7% of her Max HP physical damage to all enemy units in the path. When blinking far away or encountering the first enemy Hero, Khufra will immediately stop, dealing 50-100 plus 7% of his maximum Physical damage to nearby enemies, then knocking them into the air for up to 1.1 seconds.

Khufra uses a bandage to wrap herself in a bouncy magic ball, increasing her own physical and magical defense by 30% to 100&. Enemies attempting to use their blink skills to move through Khufra will be knocked into the air. [time required] Every time the Magic Bouncing Ball hits the ground, it will deal magic damage equal to 50-100 plus 3% of its maximum HP to nearby enemies and Slow them by 80%. Lasts 0.2 seconds.

Khufra brings all enemy targets around him towards his front, dealing and slowing them for 1.25 to 1.75 seconds. If enemies are knocked against walls, additional physical damage equal to 150% of this ability's damage will be dealt to them and they will be stunned instead of slowed.

kimmy.description: Kimmy can move and aim in different directions when using her spray gun, but cannot lock on to a specific enemy. Kimmy's Spray Gun Attack Offers. Hitting hero/non-hero enemy units restores 6/3 Starlium. At max Starlium, Kimmy's basic attacks are enhanced to deal damage and pierce targets. Kimmy keeps moving while shooting and no longer benefits from the attack speed bonus. Every 1% of Attack Speed ​​she gains is converted into 1 Magic Power.

Kimmy uses her jetpack to take flight, removing and becoming immune to slow effects. She can cross terrain and gains 90% movement speed for 1 second. While flying, she fires 4 chemical bolts at nearby enemies, each damaging and slowing them by 50% for 0.5 seconds.
Kimmy fires a Starlium beam in the target direction which immobilizes enemies in its path and damages them for 2 seconds. Gain 20 Starlium for each enemy hero hit.

Kimmy charges and fires a pull pulse in a target direction. When it hits an enemy or reaches its maximum range, it explodes to deal damage to nearby enemies and creates a force field that slows enemies within by 75%. After 1 second, the field contracts, pulling all enemy Heroes towards its center and dealing 15% of their current HP as magic damage. Gain 40 Starlium for each enemy hero hit.

lancelot.description: Each time Lancelot [blinks or] charges, his damage is increased by 7.5% for 4 seconds, up to 30%.

Lancelot charges in a designated direction, dealing damage to enemies along the way and applying a sword mark to the first unmarked enemy hit. The sword mark lasts 3 seconds. If Lancelot successfully applies a sword mark to an enemy, the cooldown will be reset.

Lancelot strikes in the target direction 3 times, dealing damage to enemies hit each time (damage reduced [to 30% | hp] when multiple enemies are hit). He is untargetable and invincible during this process. [how long?] Enemies in the center of the area will take 3 hits and be slowed by 20% for 0.5 seconds. The slow effect can stack. This skill only benefits from 50% of Lancelot's Spell Vamp.
After a short [how long?] period of charging, Lancelot executes an Executioner Strike in the target direction, dealing damage. He is invincible throughout the process. [how long ?]

lapu-lapu.description: Each time Lapu-Lapu deals damage, he gains 10 Blessing of Bravery|Rage (halved by non-hero units). When his Blessing of Bravery is full, his next basic attack or Blades of Justice will be buffed, granting Lapu-Lapu a shield capable of absorbing damage for 2.5 seconds. Improved basic attack) will cause him to rush towards the target and deal damage. This basic attack cannot be a critical hit. Improved Justice Blades will slow the target by 60% for 1 second.
Lapu-Lapu releases two boomerangs in the target direction. Each boomerang attacks enemies hit on the way out and back. Enemies hit by both boomerangs take 50% damage from the second hit.
Lapu-Lapu rushes in the target direction, dealing damage to enemies along the way.

When this energy reaches 100, his next basic attack deals 200% critical damage and restores. Mounted State: The energy gain of each Oath Keeper is increased by 200%.

Leomord charges towards a designated direction, dealing damage to enemies along the way and slowing them by 30% for 1 second.

Léomord calls Barbiel to rush towards him, dealing 100-300 base to all enemies in his path. Leomord's basic attacks and skills grant him 25 Oath Keeper energy each time they deal damage to targets. Barbiel charges in a designated direction and knocks back all enemies in the way, dealing 300 (+80% of total physical attack) physical damage.

Leomord summons Barbiel to rush towards him, knocking him back and dealing 100 (+40% of total physical attack) physical damage to all enemies in his path. lesley.description: If Lesley doesn't take damage for 5 seconds, her next basic attack gains additional range and 50% critical strike chance and deals (20% additional damage against minions). Each fixed physical penetration point and each 1% physical penetration Lesley gains is converted into 1% critical damage, but her base critical damage is reduced to 130%. Lesley's basic attack restores 5 energy, and her death shot doubles the amount of energy restored. Lethal Shot's cooldown will activate immediately after Lesley uses a skill.

Lesley enters the Camouflage state, gaining double energy regeneration, 40% additional movement speed, and 85 to 135 additional physical attacks. The condition lasts for 3 seconds or until Lesley takes or deals damage. Enemies can detect Lesley's location through distortions in their environment.

Lesley throws a tactical grenade in the target direction while jumping back slightly, dealing enemies in a cone and knocking them back. Lesley can cast this skill during Ultimate Snipe to negate the state and immediately fire a fatal bullet at the target. The attack is only triggered when there are fatal bullets left unfired.

Lesley [gains vision of nearby enemies and can lock on] to the targeted enemy hero and fires 4 deadly bullets in succession, each dealing and restoring 10 energy on a hit. Bullets can be blocked by other enemy heroes. If this skill is interrupted, each remaining bullet reduces the skill's cooldown by 10%. Passive:|e Lesley's critical strike chance is increased from 5% to 15%.

ling.description: Ling's superb lightness skill helps him jump between walls. When resting on a wall, he gains 4 Lightness points per second while on a wall and 5 additional Lightness points each time he deals damage. Ling gains 1.6x critical chance from all sources but only has 140% critical damage.

Passive: |e Ling's critical chance is permanently increased. Active:|e Ling casts her Lightness skill, jumping onto the designated wall, entering a half-stealth state, restoring Lightness points faster, and gaining 30% movement speed. If Ling takes damage, he will exit the half-stealth state. If controlled, he will fall to the ground and be slowed by 30% for 2 seconds. When you use this skill to jump from one wall to another, the cooldown will be reset and the semi-stealth state will be refreshed.

Ling charges in a designated direction and stabs nearby enemies at his destination, damaging them. If Ling casts this skill while on the wall, he will dash towards the target location on the ground, dealing damage to enemies in a small area and Slowing them by 30% for 1.5 seconds. If this attack lands a critical hit, enemies will be slowed by an additional 45% for 0.75 seconds. Defiant Sword is considered a basic attack and can trigger attack effects.

Ling jumps into the air, becoming invincible and gaining 10% additional movement speed for 1.5 seconds. He can move freely when in the air. Four Bladestorms will also appear near the Field of Swords. Ling can touch them to reduce the cooldown of Finch Poise by 4 seconds, reset the cooldown of Defiant Sword, and gain 25 Lightness.

lolita.description: Every 2.5 seconds, the Noumenon Energy Core grants one to Lolita and her nearby allies. This shield can stack up to 6 times and lasts 30 seconds.

Lolita rushes in the target direction. His next basic attack within 4 seconds will make a short dash towards the target, dealing and stunning them for 0.5 seconds. This damage is doubled against Minions.

Lolita raises her shield and reflects all incoming basic attacks and ranged projectiles in the direction of the shield for 3 seconds. The shield will break after taking damage. Damage and effects from Unique Passives from an attacker's equipment will not apply to the shield and will not be reflected.

Lolita begins charging for 2 seconds while slowing enemies in a fan-shaped area by 50%. When the charge is completed or stopped, Lolita slams the ground with her hammer, dealing up to 400 enemies in the area and stunning them for up to 2 seconds (damage and stun duration are based on charge time). Reuse:|e Lolita immediately stops charging and hits the ground with her hammer.

lukas.description: Lukas gains 1 Resolve per second and 2 additional Resolve when dealing damage to heroes. Lukas consumes 10 Resolve per second while in Holy Beast form.

Passive: Lukas can buff Flash Combo with his basic attacks up to 2 times, lasting 4 seconds. Lukas consumes all Stamina to trigger Pulverize, dealing, plus additional attacks depending on the Stamina consumed (recovers HP equal to 8% of Max HP when hitting a hero): 1 Stack: Lukas briefly stuns the target and swings his tonfa hammers to deal 3 times, drawing the enemy towards him. 2 charges: Lukas briefly stuns the target and follows up with 2 attacks that deal per hit. Lukas dashes in the target direction and transforms his next basic attack in 4 seconds into a Flash Strike. Flash Strike: Lukas blinks behind the enemy and deals damage. He then increases his attack range, gains 20% movement speed and 20% attack speed, and summons storms with basic attacks to deal additional damage, lasting 4 seconds.

Lukas transforms into his sacred beast form. In this state, his base movement speed is increased by 30, all attributes are increased by 15%, and his skills gain new effects. Use Again: Lukas in Holy Beast form fires a shockwave in the target direction that will explode when he hits an enemy hero or reaches maximum range, dealing. "All attributes" includes HP, physical attack, attack speed, physical and magic defense, and attack range.

Lukas gains 0.5 Resolve per second and 2 Resolve when dealing damage to heroes. After reaching 100 Resolve, he can use Unleash the Beast to transform into a holy beast. Holy Beast: Greatly increases combat attributes. It continually consumes Resolve and ends when Resolve is exhausted.

Passive: Basic attacks grant Stamina (up to 2 stacks), each stack lasting 4 seconds. Vigor improves Flash Combo. Lukas consumes all of his stamina to unleash a tail slash, dealing 220 (+120% of total physical attack) physical damage and recovering 5% of his maximum HP when he hits a hero. 1 stack: Lukas briefly stuns the target and leaps, dealing 100 (+45% of total physical attack) physical damage 3 times and knocking back the enemy. 2 charges: Lukas briefly stuns the target and leaps, dealing 50 (+20% of total physical attack) physical damage 2 times. Next, he summons Holy Lightning, dealing 100 (+45% of total physical attack) physical damage 3 times while gaining control immunity for the duration.

Lukas dashes in the targeted direction and transforms his next basic attack within 4 seconds into Lightning Clash. Flash Shock: Lukas charges towards the enemy, knocking them back, dealing 60 (+125% of total physical attack) physical damage. He then gains 20% Movement Speed ​​and Attack Speed, and summons Holy Lightning with basic attacks to deal 50 (+25% of total physical attack) additional physical damage, lasting 4 seconds.

The Holy Beast fires a shockwave in the target direction (gains control immunity while casting) that will explode upon hitting an enemy hero or reaching its maximum range, dealing 450 (+155% of total physical attack) physical damage.

Lunox summons a shower of starlight onto nearby enemies, damaging them. Starlight then returns to Lunox, each restoring and recovering. Restored HP is doubled when hitting enemy heroes. Grants a charge of Power of Order after use.
Lunox unleashes chaos energy on an enemy, dealing magic damage equal to (1.5% - 3% of maximum HP against Creeps). Grants a charge of Chaos Power after use.

Lunox is twisted by the powers of Chaos and Order. When Lunox uses Power of Order|e, she gains Brilliance|e and becomes invincible while dealing continuous damage to nearby enemies. Lunox is twisted by the powers of Chaos and Order. When using the power of order, she gains 0.5% Spell Vamp for every 1% magic penetration. When using the power of chaos, she gains 0.5% magic penetration for every 1% of Spell Vamp.

Lunox summons a shower of starlight onto nearby enemies, dealing 200 (+110% total magic power) magic damage. Lunox unleashes chaos energy on a targeted enemy, dealing 250 (+120% total magic power) (+2.5% of target's maximum health) magic damage (+1.5% of target's maximum health against creeps). Lunox channels the power of Order and Chaos in the targeted direction, dealing 300 (+150% of total Magic Power) magic damage to enemies in its path and Slowing them by 40% for 2 seconds.

The state of this skill changes each time it is cast.

lylia.description: Lylia gains the power of Gloom|color=indigo, increasing her movement speed by 15%|ms whenever she is in Gloom|color=indigo's area. Martis draws enemies to a fan-shaped area in front of him and deals with them, slowing them by 40% for 2 seconds.

Martis gains control immunity and 60% damage reduction when casting this skill.

Martis lunges at a designated enemy Hero, dealing (deals true damage if the enemy's HP is below 50%). If the enemy is killed by this skill, Martis can recast the skill within 10 seconds and gains 100% additional movement speed which gradually decreases over 5 seconds. Each successive cast also increases the skill's damage by 15% (up to 30%).

masha.description: Blessed by the Bear King, Masha has 3 bars of HP and will not die until they are all depleted. She can ignore one instance of damage each time she loses a bar of HP. When Masha has only two bars of HP left, skills will only require 50% of their original HP cost to cast. When Masha has only one HP bar left, she does not need to spend HP to cast skills.

Active:|e Masha spends 24% of her HP to increase her movement speed by 60% for 1.5 seconds.
