Masha spends 24% of her HP to roar at enemies, dealing and reducing their attack speed by 50% for 2 seconds.

Masha spends 34% of her HP to lunge at an enemy hero (immune to control effects while lunging), slowing them by 25% for 2 seconds and knocking back nearby enemies. The cooldown of this skill will be reset every time Masha loses a bar of HP.

Masha gains energy when dealing damage to enemies and additional energy when dealing damage with Wild Power. After leaving combat for 3 seconds, Masha can activate this skill to spend half a full bar of energy to recover a full bar of HP. Masha is invincible when casting this skill.

mathilda.description: Mathilda benefits from ancestral advice while moving. When fully charged, her next basic attack will be enhanced, inflicting and granting the target a movement speed of 80 which will decrease over 2.5 seconds.

Mathilda resonates with the power of her ancestors for 4 seconds, attracting wisps that increase as her movement distance increases (up to 6 wisps). At the end of the skill's duration, or when Mathilda casts this skill again, the wisps will seek to attack nearby enemies, each dealing and briefly revealing the enemies' position. [time required] Subsequent damage dealt by Wisps to the same target is reduced to 40%.

Mathilda jumps in the target direction and creates a field around herself, gaining 1 and 25% additional movement speed for 3 seconds. Allied heroes who come into contact with terrain will receive 60% shield and Guiding Wind|e. The first allied hero to trigger Guiding Wind will be guided towards Mathilda, and both will benefit from the same movement speed boost. When casting this skill during Circling Eagle, Mathilda will not change position. Guiding Wind expires 2 seconds after the hero leaves Mathilda's field.

Mathilda applies a Soul Mark|mark to the targeted enemy hero and circles around them for up to 3.5 seconds, during which her wisps will fly towards nearby enemy heroes, each dealing. Soul Bloom 2 will prioritize targeting with Soul Mark. During the duration, Mathilda can select an area to rush to. At the end of the duration, she will rush to the target with Soul Mark|mark, dealing while knocking enemies in her path into the air for 0.6 seconds and transferring the Soul Mark to the first enemy hero she knocks into the air. Mathilda gains control immunity for the duration of the skill.

“Watch me slide forward and increase my attack speed for 3 seconds – Ah, that was just annoying…” “Muddles, go that way!” “Hugs, come here!” (Skill cooldown is reduced by 0.5 seconds each time Melissa damages the enemy while attacking Muddles.)

The field will move with Melissa once, when she is about to get out of limit Passive: Melissa's physical and magical defense is increased by 3. (This effect is increased to 5 times when the skill is active.)

minotaur.description: When the Minotaur uses a skill, it gains Motivation for 3 seconds and heals itself for % of the damage dealt by enemy heroes. These effects are doubled in Enraged state.

The Minotaur jumps towards the target location, dealing damage to enemies in the area and briefly knocking them into the air. Enemies hit will be Slowed by 40% while upgrading his Minotaur buffs his basic attacks to deal additional physical damage for 2 seconds. Enraged: Increases AOE range and damage dealt by physical damage.
The Minotaur motivates itself and the most injured hero nearby, recovering and healing itself based on its [8%] [check needed] HP|HP lost. Enraged: The Minotaur heals itself and nearby allies.

The Minotaur enters the Enraged state and crushes the ground 3 times. The first 2 hits deal to nearby enemies and slow them by 60% while the final hit deals, while knocking targets into the air for 0.8 seconds. The Minotaur is immune to control effects during this attack. The Enraged state lasts 12 seconds and improves the Minotaur's skills for this duration.

minsitthar.description: Minsitthar's basic attacks and skills apply a stack of Mark of the King|mark, up to 5 stacks. After reaching the maximum number of stacks, the next attack detonates all stacks of Mark of the King, damaging and stunning the target for 0.8 seconds while healing Minsitthar. Can only trigger once every 6 seconds on the same target.

Minsitthar advances with the Spear of Glory, dealing and slowing enemies hit by 30%. Enemy heroes hit by the tip of the spear will be stunned for 0.6 seconds. After a short delay, Minsitthar removes the spear, dealing damage to all enemies in the path and dragging enemy Heroes hit towards him.

Minsitthar awakens the power of his shield and unleashes it, dealing all enemies in a rectangular area and slowing them by 80% (rapidly decaying over 2 seconds). During this time, he enters the Phalanx|e state for 3 seconds, reducing damage taken from the front by 25-50% and buffing his basic attack to quickly strike an area in front of him with each hit.

Minsitthar charges forward and calls 4 royal guards to form a field around him. Royal Guards cannot move but will attack enemies on the ground. Enemies on the field are slowed by 20% and cannot use movement skills.

miya.description: Each time Miya hits a target with her basic attack, she gains 5% attack speed for 4 seconds. Stacks up to 5 times. After reaching full stacks, Miya summons a Lunar Shadow with each basic attack that inflicts and inherits part of the attack effects.

Miya fires two additional arrows with each basic attack, dealing 30% damage to the target enemy and nearby targets. This effect lasts 4 seconds. Each additional arrow inherits part of the attack effects.

Miya launches a powerful arrow at the target area, damaging enemies inside and immobilizing them for 1.2 seconds. The arrow then splits into 6 scattered minor arrows, each dealing damage to the first enemy hit and slowing them by 30% for 2 seconds.

Miya removes all debuffs on her and hides, gaining 65% additional movement speed. This state lasts for 2 seconds or until she launches an attack. Miya gains full stacks of Moon Blessing upon leaving the state.

moskov.description: Moskov's basic attacks can penetrate the target and deal [(+ physical attack)] to enemies behind them (inherits attack effects). Each basic attack hit reduces the cooldowns of Abyss Walker and Spear of Misery by 0.5 seconds.
Moskov teleports to the target location, increasing his attack speed by 1.15 to 1.5 times for 3 seconds. Meanwhile, its basic attack deals 10% more damage to enemies behind the main target.

Moskov launches a powerful strike at the targeted enemy Hero or Creep, hitting them, knocking them back, and revealing their location for 5 seconds. If the target collides with an enemy hero while knocked back, they will both be stunned for 1.5 seconds. If the enemy is knocked against a wall, they will also be stunned for the same duration.

When hitting an enemy hero, the spear pierces him and deals damage to enemies behind him. The target and enemies hit by piercing damage are slowed by 50% for 1 second (slow duration scales with the spear's movement time, up to 3 seconds). When the Spear of Destruction hits the first enemy hero, it creates a shadow behind them and refreshes the cooldown of Abyss Walker. Use again: |e Moskov casts Abyss Walker from shadow slot (shares the same cooldown as the normal skill.

nana.description: After taking lethal damage, Nana removes all debuffs and transforms, becoming untargetable and invincible, and gains 30% Movement Speed ​​for 2 seconds. Nana throws her Magic Boomerang in the targeted direction, dealing damage to enemies hit on the way there and back. The boomerang deals to the first enemy. For each additional enemy hit, damage is reduced by 20% (maximum reduction of 60%).

Nana summons Molina to the target location. After a short delay. Molina will pursue the closest enemy hero within range for 2.5 seconds. Molina will take care of the first enemy hero he collides with and transform him for 1.5 seconds, also slow him down by 50% and reduce his magic defense by 25% for the duration. If there are no enemy heroes in range, Molina will disappear after 12 seconds.
Nana summons Molina to hit the target area 3 times, each time dealing damage to enemies in the area and slowing them by 50% for 1 second. Enemies hit consecutively will be stunned for 1 second.

natalia.description: If Natalia stays in a bush without taking damage for 1 second, she will enter stealth and gain 15% movement speed. In this state, Natalia's next basic attack will teleport her behind her target and hex them while silencing them for 0.25 seconds. Dealing damage, taking damage, or using skills will immediately end the stealth state, but his next basic attack will remain enhanced for an additional 1 second. Natalia's base critical damage is reduced to 150%, but her damage dealt to Creeps is increased to 150%.
Natalia dashes in the target direction, dealing damage to enemies in her path. After hitting an enemy, she can cast this skill again within 5 seconds.
Natalia throws a smoke bomb at her location, slowing nearby enemies by 25-75%, while Natalia becomes immune to enemy basic attacks for 4 seconds.

Passive: Natalia gains an additional 15-45% critical chance. Active: Natalia immediately enters the Assassin Instinct state. Natalia can store up to 2 charges of her Ultimate and each charge has a cooldown of 30 seconds. Creep kills will reduce the current remaining cooldown by 50% of the full cooldown.

natan.description: Natan gains a charge of Entanglement each time he or his Reverse-Clone hits an enemy with an ability (up to 6 charges). Each stack lasts 2.5 seconds and grants 7.5% additional attack speed and 5% movement speed. Natan's basic attack projectiles will return to Natan after reaching maximum range, dealing an additional 30 points to enemies along the way (inheriting 60% of Natan's attack effects). Hitting an enemy resets the duration of Entanglement.
Natan projects a dense mass of energy, dealing damage to enemies in his path.

Natan launches a gravitational attractor that transports enemies on contact along the path and deals with them. The attractor explodes upon reaching the end, knocking back nearby enemies, stunning them for 0.1 seconds, and dealing damage.

Natan summons a Reverse-Clone|e at a 6-unit target location that lasts for 10 seconds, inherits 35% / 37.5% / 40% of his attack attributes (and 35% of Natan's attack effects), and copies his moves and attacks in reverse. Reuse: Natan changes places with the Reverse-Clone. [Cooldown: 12 seconds.] Each cast reduces the remaining cooldowns of other skills by 50%. The Reverse-Clone will disappear if Natan is too far away.

nolan.description: Nolan's skills will leave a Rift that lasts 5 seconds and slows enemies by 30%. When a Rift comes into contact with another Rift, it activates and draws enemies to its center and deals with them after a short delay. Every time a Rift Activation hits an enemy Hero or Creep, Nolan will gain 15 Energy and heal himself. If an enemy is hit by multiple Rift activations, the damage after the first hit will be reduced to 40%. Cosmic Leap:|e If Nolan neither deals nor takes damage for 5 seconds, he upgrades his next basic attack to dash towards the target, dealing and leaving a breach. (Damage to Minions or Creeps will not prevent Nolan from obtaining this effect.)
Nolan cuts a rectangular area in front of him with his Cosmic Gauge, inflicting and leaving a gap on the enemy's first hit.
Nolan charges in the target direction and strikes with his Cosmic Gauge, dealing damage to enemies in his path and leaving a Rift.
Nolan cuts the target location 3 times, with each hit while leaving 3 Rifts and slowing the hit target by 30% for 0.5 sec. Rifts will be activated automatically while Nolan rushes back.

novaria.description: Astral Spheres summoned by Novaria will continually slow nearby enemies by 20% and grant them vision [for 2 seconds].

Novaria summons an Astral Sphere to the target location. continuously dealing damage to nearby enemies [six times]. After 2 seconds, the sphere will explode, dealing damage to nearby enemies and increasing the slow effect of Astral Sphere to 2.5 times the original slow effect (50% slow).

Novaria summons an astral sphere from a distance and draws it towards her. At the same time, Novaria gains 80% movement speed (which decreases to 30% movement speed over time) and can traverse terrain. When the Astral Sphere reaches Novaria, she can launch it in a target direction within 5 seconds. The sphere will explode when hitting an enemy hero, dealing damage. Damage will increase based on the distance the Astral Sphere moves (from when the Sphere is summoned) up to 2.2 times (120%) of the original.

Novaria disperses Astral Echo in the target direction, briefly slowing hit enemy Heroes by 50% (for approximately 0.8 seconds) while applying Astral Ring|e on them, increasing their hitbox by 2.5 times and revealing their surrounding area. This effect lasts 5 seconds.

obsidia.description: When Obsidia deals damage to enemies, she gains Bone Energy (basic attacks against non-hero units grant 1 Energy, against hero units grant 2 Energy, and skills grant 3 times Energy. No Energy is gained from hitting creeps). When the bone energy reaches 30, it forms a bone fragment, up to 25 fragments. When Obsidia uses basic attacks, all bone shards hit the target, each dealing (7% of total physical attack) physical damage and inheriting 7% of attack effects.
Obsidia launches an Abyssal Bone Needle, inflicting damage on enemies hit and triggering Return to Bone on the enemy hero's first attack.
Obsidia descends into the Abyss and enters Shadowmeld form, gaining 500% movement speed for 0.3 sec.

Obsidia fires at Bones of Wrath, in the target direction, briefly dealing and stunning the first enemy hero hit, and closes in on them. The Wrath Bones then attach themselves to the enemy, preventing Obsidia from moving more than 4 units away. The enemy cannot use their movement skills and their movement will drag Obsidia away. During this time, Obsidia gains 5 temporary bone fragments. This effect lasts 3 seconds. Meanwhile, Obsidia can pass through obstacles and use basic attacks while moving. Phantom Shadowmeld is buffed, with its duration increased to 1 second and cooldown reduced to 33%.

odette.description: After each skill cast, Odette's next basic attack or skill will launch a sound wave that bounces between her and enemies, with each bounce dealing.
Odette focuses her energy to summon a swan to attack enemies, damaging them and slowing them by 30%. Lasts 2 seconds.

Odette releases a series of magical energy balls forward, damaging the hit enemy and immobilizing them for 1.5 seconds. Another energy ball will then appear and attack a nearby enemy (prioritizing enemy heroes), damaging and immobilizing them for 1.5 seconds.

Odette gathers energy and begins channeling, gaining one and dealing a total to enemies in the area for 5 seconds. (It deals damage every 0.5 sec). Lakeshore Ambience's bounce speed and number of sound waves in the area are also improved while the skill is active. Reuse: Within 5 seconds to jump in the designated direction without interrupting the pipeline. This skill requires constant channeling and will be interrupted if Odette is controlled by a high level CC such as Suppression, affected by air, is transformed or etc or when Odette performs other actions.

paquito.description: Every 3 skill casts, Paquito enters Champion Stance, gaining an upgraded skill ignoring its current cooldowns. He gains 60% additional movement speed which decreases over 2.5 seconds after casting the improved skill. Paquito's basic attacks just deal.

Paquito throws a punch in the target direction, dealing damage to enemies hit. He gains 2.5 seconds if an enemy hero is hit. Champion Stance:|e Damage is increased to, while shield value is increased to 120%|shield. Regular and enhanced shields can stack.

Paquito rushes in the target direction and throws a jab, dealing damage to enemies hit. Paquito deals no damage to enemies in his path, but will stop and throw the jab as soon as he collides with an enemy hero or creep. Champion Position:|eDamage is increased to.

Paquito throws an elbow strike in the target direction, damaging enemies hit and knocking them back. He then throws a haymaker, dealing damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 75% for 1 second, while he backs up. Champion Stance:|e Instead of a haymaker, Paquito throws an uppercut after the elbow strike at enemies hit and sends them flying into the air for 0.5 seconds.

pharsa.description: Every 8 seconds, Verri enters a hunting state and assists Pharsa in her next attack against an enemy Hero, dealing an additional 8% magic damage equal to the target's maximum HP (+1% for every 200 Magic Power possessed) and Slowing them by 60% for 1 second.

Pharsa unleashes a burst of magic at the target location, damaging and marking enemies hit for 4 seconds. Pharsa's subsequent attack against marked enemies will consume the mark and stun them for 1 second.
Pharsa releases magical energy in the targeted direction, dealing damage to enemies hit.

Passive: Each level up of this skill reduces the spiritual unit's interval by 1 second. Active: Pharsa takes flight for 8 seconds and bombards the target location, dealing damage to enemies in the area. This skill can be cast up to 4 times during the duration.

Pharsa transforms into mist and wraps around Verri, gaining 150% additional movement speed (decreasing over time) and the ability to hover over terrain for 5 seconds. This state ends immediately when she is controlled or uses a basic attack or skill.

phoveus.description: Phoveus's next basic attack allows him to charge the enemy, knocking them back, dealing an additional 4% of the enemy's maximum HP and gaining a shield equal to 8% of their maximum HP. This effect has a cooldown of 26 to 14 seconds (depending on Infernal Pursuit level). Gaze of Astaros: Whenever an enemy Hero blinks, dashes, or is moved within 8 units of Phoveus, the cooldown of Demonic Strength will be reduced by 20% and the cooldown of their other skills will be reduced by 0.5 seconds.

Phoveus throws his monolith onto the ground, dealing damage to enemies in the area and Slowing them by 70% for 0.5 seconds. If this ability hits an enemy, Phoveus' next demonic strike will leave behind an Eye of Astaros. Astaros Eye: Implodes after a short delay, dealing damage to enemies.
Phoveus drops the stone and unleashes his demonic power in the target direction, knocking enemies into the air, dragging them, and inflicting them.

Sinner|e: Demonic Force, Astaros Eye, and Dark Wave can apply the Mark of the Sinner to the enemy hero hit. Judgment: Phoveus leaps into the air and crashes his monolith into the enemy Hero with the Sinner's Mark, dealing additional Physical damage equal to 5% of the target's maximum HP to enemies in the area while Phoveus recovers 50 plus 6% of his lost HP. HP recovered is reduced by 80% when you hit multiple enemies.

popol-and-kupa.description: Popol's good healing allows Kupa to recover 10% of his maximum HP per second after not taking damage for 5 seconds. When Kupa is down, Popol can pray for 3 seconds to return him to the battlefield. Cooldown: 30 seconds. After launching 3 consecutive attacks on the enemy, Kupa will enhance Popol's enhanced basic attack (Popol and Kupa), allowing him to deal hits. Kupa possesses and inherits 100% of Popol's other equipment attributes and effects (excluding those from active, jungle, and roaming equipment).

Popol throws a spear at the target and commands Kupa to bite it, dealing and chaining attacks for 3 seconds. Alpha Wolf Form: Kupa strikes fiercely, stunning the target for 1 second with 3 rapid bites.

Popol summons Kupa to protect him, buying time by damaging nearby enemies and slowing them by 35% for 0.5 seconds. Kupa will assist Popol in combat for 3 seconds. Alpha Wolf Form: Kupa steps back to protect his master and knocks nearby enemies into the air|CC for 0.2 seconds. Shield and damage increased to 125%.

Popol and Kupa enter the Enraged state for 12 seconds: Both Popol and Kupa gain 15% additional movement speed and increase their attack speed to 1.3 times. Kupa transforms into Alpha Wolf Form|e, acquiring and improving his other skills. Also fully restores his HP.

Popol and Kupa enter the Enraged state for 12 seconds, gaining 15% additional movement speed and increasing their attack speed to 1.3 times. Kupa transforms into Alpha Wolf Form, gaining an additional 1,500 Max HP, fully restoring his HP, while also improving his other skills.

Kupa recovers 10% of his maximum HP per second after not taking damage for 5 seconds. When Kupa is killed, Popol can pray for 3 seconds to return Kupa to the battlefield. Cooldown: 30 seconds. Every 3 consecutive attacks from Kupa will enhance Popol's next basic attack to deal (+220% of total physical attack) physical damage. Kupa has 2500 (+1200% of total physical attack) maximum HP and inherits 100% of Popol's other attributes and passive equipment effects (excluding jungle and roaming equipment effects). Kupa deals 120% more damage to Creeps.

Popol throws a spear at the target enemy, dealing 80 (+100% of total physical attack) physical damage while simultaneously commanding Kupa to lunge at the target, dealing 70 (+75% of total physical attack) additional physical damage. Kupa will continue to attack the target for 3 seconds. Alpha Wolf Form: Kupa stuns the enemy for 1 second and bites them 3 times in a row.

Popol summons Kupa to his side, gaining a 240 (+200% additional Physical Attack) shield while dealing 240 (+50% total Physical Attack) physical damage to nearby enemies and Slowing them by 35% for 0.5 sec. Kupa will then help Popol attack nearby enemies for 3 seconds. Alpha Wolf Form: Kupa returns to Popol, knocking nearby enemies into the air for 0.2 seconds. Shield and damage increased to 125%.

Popol places a trap at the target location which will explode after a short delay once triggered, dealing 70 (+20% total magic power) magic damage to the enemy who steps on it, immobilizing them for 1 second and creating a freeze zone for 4 seconds. Enemies in the freeze zone will have their movement speed reduced by 20%. Popol gains a trap charge every 22 seconds (up to 3). Up to 3 traps can exist on the battlefield at the same time, each lasting up to 60 seconds.

Popol and Kupa enter the Enraged state for 12 seconds, gaining 15% additional movement speed and increasing their attack speed to 1.3 times. Kupa transforms into Alpha Wolf Form, gaining an additional 1,500 Max HP, fully restoring his HP, while also improving his other skills.

rafaela.description: At regular intervals, Rafaela can use a special ability to instantly resurrect a fallen allied hero after a brief channeling. The revived allied hero will reappear at the base and benefit from increased movement speed. This skill's cooldown is determined by both its base cooldown and the resurrected hero's remaining respawn time. It is not affected by cooldown reduction.

Rafaela hits the three closest enemies with Light of Smite, inflicting a bolt of lightning on them, briefly revealing their positions and slowing them by 40% for 1.5 seconds. Enemies hit by Light of Retribution again within 5 seconds will take 20% additional damage (this effect stacks up to 3 times).

Rafaela calls upon Holy Light|e, restoring nearby allied heroes, as well as herself and the most injured allied hero within range. Also increases the movement speed of nearby allied Heroes by 30% and grants immunity to Slow for 1 second. Every 20 points of Magic Power will add 1% to the movement speed bonus, up to 80%.
Rafaela unleashes the true power of Holy Light|e in the target direction, dealing to enemies in line and stunning them for 1.5 seconds.

roger.description: Roger can freely switch between human form and wolf form. In human form, Roger's basic attacks and skills deal bonus damage equal to [(+4% of the target's current HP)|HP.] In wolf form, Roger's basic attack and skills deal bonus damage equal to [(+4% of the target's lost HP)|HP.] This effect can only deal up to 60 bonus damage against Creeps.

Roger fires two rapid shots in the target direction, dealing a total of damage to the hit enemy. The first shot is a Hunter Net that slows the enemy by 80% for 1.5 seconds, while the second is a bullet that reduces the enemy's physical defense by 5 seconds.
Roger gains 20-40% Movement Speed ​​and 20-40% Attack Speed ​​for 2.5 seconds.

Roger lunges in the target direction and transforms into a wolf, dealing damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 90% for 0.8 seconds. Passive:|e In wolf form, Roger gains 20 to 65 physical and magical defense and 25 movement speed.

Roger can freely switch between human form and wolf form. In human form, Roger's basic attack and skills deal bonus damage equal to 4% of the target's current HP. While in Wolf Form, Roger's Basic Attack and Skills deal bonus damage equal to 4% of the target's HP lost. This effect can only deal up to 60 additional damage against Creeps.

Roger lunges at the targeted enemy, becoming untargetable, while dealing 250 (+125% of total physical attack) physical damage to up to 3 enemies in the area. Getting a kill or assist will reduce the cooldown of this skill by 80%.

Roger lets out a howl, increasing his attack speed by 1.15 times for 5 seconds and revealing nearby enemy Heroes with HP below 40%. If there are enemy heroes with HP below 40% within range, Roger gains 50% movement speed.
Roger rolls in the targeted direction and returns to human form, gaining a shield of 200 (+200% additional physical attack) for 1.5 seconds.

ruby.description: Ruby gains 6-20% Spell Vamp (depending on level) and inherits a 125% Spell Vamp ratio (basic attacks cannot trigger Lifesteal). After each skill cast, Ruby can rush to another location, gaining physical and magical defense (scales with level) for 4 seconds. (cumulative up to 3 times).
Ruby swings her scythe, dealing damage to enemies hit. She then unleashes a shockwave in the same direction, dealing damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 40% for 1 second.
Ruby herself throws her scythe twice, with each swing dealing damage to nearby enemies, stunning them for 0.5 seconds and slowly pulling them towards her.
Ruby swings the scythe in the target direction, dealing damage to enemies hit, pulling them towards her and stunning them for 0.5 seconds.

saber.description: Saber attacks reduce enemies' Physical Defense by 3-8 for 5 seconds when hit. This effect stacks up to 5 times.

Saber fires 5 swords that spin around him, dealing damage to enemies on contact. After circling around Saber for about 5 seconds, the swords will return to Saber. During the duration of this skill, when Saber deals damage with her basic attacks or skills, she will send a sword into orbit towards the target, dealing 50% damage to the main target and other targets she passes through and reducing the cooldown of Charge by 1 second. It only deals 50% damage to all non-hero enemies such as minions and creeps.

Saber dashes in the target direction, dealing damage to enemies while buffing her next basic attack. Saber can dash towards the target and her enhanced basic attack deals and slows the target by 60% for 1 second.
Saber charges at the targeted enemy hero, knocking them into the air for 1.2 seconds and hitting them 3 times during this duration. The first two hits deal each, while the third hit deals.

selena.description: Selena can freely switch between her two forms. Elven Form: Selena applies "Abyssal Mark" with her skills. The mark can stack up to 2 times. When Abyssal Trap hits an enemy, it immediately adds an "Abyssal Mark". Abyssal Form: All damage will consume 1 stack of "Abyssal Mark" to deal additional magic damage. “Abyssal Mark” deals 285% more damage to non-hero units.

Selena summons an Abyssal Devil to hide in a designated location. The Abyssal Devil will attach itself to any enemy that approaches the location and slow them by 50%. After 3 seconds, the Abyssal Devil attacks the enemy and other nearby enemies, slowing them by 50% for 1 second. The Abyssal Devil lasts up to 60 seconds. Up to 3 Abyssal Devils can exist at the same time. Each additional Abyssal Devil increases final damage by 50%.

Selena fires magic arrows in a designated direction, damaging the first enemy Hero hit and stunning them for 0.5 seconds to 2.5 seconds. Stun duration and damage increase with the distance the arrows travel. The arrow absorbs the Abyssal Trap as it moves and will therefore apply the effects of “Abyssal Traps” to the enemy target when hit. If an enemy is stunned for 0.9 seconds or more, Selena's movement speed will be increased by 40% for 2 seconds.

Selena enters Abyssal Form and increases her movement speed by 30% for 0.8 seconds. Immediately resets the Soul Eater and Garotte CD. Abyssal Form: Selena learns new skills. Its basic attack will deal additional magic damage. Passive: Selena gains 5 to 20 additional magic power.

Selena can freely switch between her two forms. Elven Form: Selena applies Abyssal Mark when her skills deal damage. Marks last 8 seconds and can stack up to 2 times. Abyssal Form: Selena's basic attacks transform into melee and deal (+25% total magic power) bonus magic damage. Her skills deal an additional 240-450 (+40% total Magic Power) magic damage to enemies with the Abyssal Mark and consume their Mark charges by 1. This damage is increased to 250% against Creeps and minions.

Selena empowers her claws with the power of the Abyss, allowing the next basic attack to dash at a target and deal an additional 200 (+130% total Magic Power) magic damage while granting her a shield of 300 (+150% total Magic Power). If this damage detonates an Abyssal Mark, Garotte's cooldown will be reset.

Selena charges in the targeted direction, dealing 150 (+50% total magic power) magic damage to enemies in her path. If the damage from this skill detonates an Abyssal Mark, its cooldown will be reset.
Passive: Gain 5 magic power. Active: Selena enters Elven form, gaining 20% ​​Movement Speed ​​for 0.8 seconds and immediately resetting the cooldowns of Abyssal Trap and Abyssal Arrow.

silvanna.description: Agreement on Silvanna's basic attacks. Silvanna's attacks apply a mark to enemy heroes for 5 seconds when hit, with each mark reducing their physical and magical defense by 3-6 (up to 5 stacks). Silvanna deals 30% more damage to enemy heroes with the maximum number of marks.
Silvanna rushes forward. When she reaches maximum range or hits a non-minion enemy, she swings her spear, dealing damage to nearby enemies and stunning them for 1 second.

Silvanna pushes her spear in the target direction and spins it 6 times while gaining one. Each round treats and lightly pulls the targets toward the center. Silvanna spins 1 additional time for every 50% additional attack speed she has. The skill only deals 50% damage to minions. Spiral Choke counts as a basic attack but cannot critically hit.

Silvanna jumps to the target location and creates a circle of light upon landing, dealing 350 (+110% total Magic Power) magic damage to enemies in the area, Slowing them by 40% for 1.5 sec, and restraining the enemy Hero closest to the area for 3.5 sec. (This skill cannot be interrupted.) Silvanna gains 100% attack speed and 40% lifesteal while in the circle.

sora.description: Sora can ascend to Thunder or Torrent using his Shifting Skies. After your ascension, dealing damage to heroes or summoned units grants 1 stack of Cloudstep. At 5 charges, he unlocks his true art. Thunder: Converts 30% of max HP into physical attack at a ratio of 10%, adopting an assassin style. Torrent: Converts each physical attack point into up to 10 HP, adopting a tank style.
Sora punches twice, dealing, then lunges forward, dealing. He can dash after hitting.

Sora jumps forward and gets busy. If he hits an enemy hero or reaches maximum range, he slams the ground, dealing an additional hit and slowing him by 40% for 0.5 seconds. Successful hits reduce the cooldown by 2 seconds.

Swipe left to climb into Thunder for 10 seconds. Sora gains a brief movement speed bonus and becomes untargetable. He then summons lightning to strike nearby enemies 3 times, dealing damage with each hit. Swipe right to go up in Torrent for 10 seconds. After a brief delay, Sora attracts nearby enemies and deals.

Sora can ascend to Thunder or Torrent using his Ultimate. After your ascension, dealing damage to heroes or summoned units grants 1 stack of Cloudstep. Upon reaching 5 charges, he unlocks his true art. Thunder: Adopts an assassin style, converting 30% of max HP into physical attack (equal to 10% of max HP). Torrent: Adopts a tank style, converting 30% physical attack into maximum HP (gains 10 HP for each attack).
Sora strikes four times, dealing 140 (+50% of total Physical Attack) physical damage, then lunges forward, dealing 240 (+5% of total Health) physical damage. He can move freely during this skill.

Sora leaps forward, dealing 120 (+45% of total physical attack) physical damage. When hitting a hero or reaching maximum distance, he summons a thunderstorm, dealing 120 (+6% of total HP) physical damage and slowing enemies by 50% for 0.5 sec. This skill can be cast again within 4 seconds if it hits an enemy.
Sora jumps into the air and hits a target area 16 times, dealing 60 (+40% of total physical attack) physical damage with each hit. Sora can move freely and ignore terrain during this skill.

Sora can ascend to Thunder or Torrent using his Ultimate. After your ascension, dealing damage to heroes or summoned units grants 1 stack of Cloudstep. Upon reaching 5 charges, he unlocks his true art. Thunder: Adopts an assassin style, converting 30% of max HP into physical attack (equal to 10% of max HP). Torrent: Adopts a tank style, converting 30% physical attack into maximum HP (gains 10 HP for each attack).

Sora strikes twice, dealing 140 (+50% of total physical attack) physical damage and slowing enemies by 40%. He then lunges forward, dealing 240 (+5% of total HP) physical damage and stunning enemies for 0.5 seconds.

Sora leaps forward, dealing 140 (+55% of total physical attack) physical damage, knocking enemies into the air and knocking them back to the landing point. It then crushes the ground, knocking enemies into the air again for 0.5 seconds, dealing 140 (+8% of total HP) Physical damage and Slowing them by 50% for 1 second. Hits reduce cooldown by 2 seconds.

Sora jumps into the air and hits the target area 5 times, dealing 100 (+6% of total HP) physical damage and briefly stunning enemies with each hit. Sora can move freely and ignore terrain during this skill.

sun.description: Enemies hit by Sun and his Doppelgangers will have their Physical Defense reduced by 5% (cumulative up to 6 times). Sun recovers HP equal to 75 plus 25% of the Doppelganger's Physical Attack each time a Doppelganger deals damage. Basic attacks from Sun and his Doppelgangers deal 50 additional damage to Creeps.

Sun throws his golden staff in the targeted direction, dealing damage to enemies in his path. Upon hitting an enemy Hero or Creep, or reaching maximum range, the Golden Staff transforms into a Doppelganger that lasts for 5 seconds and inherits 40-55% of Sun's attributes (and part of its attack effects). Endless Variety and Swift Exchange are learned and leveled together and share the same cooldown.

Sun throws his golden staff in the targeted direction, dealing damage to enemies in his path. He summons a Doppelganger to his location which lasts 5 seconds and inherits 40 to 55% of his attributes (and part of the attack effects). Meanwhile, Sun hides and moves around with the golden staff.
Sun summons a Doppelganger that lasts for 8 seconds and inherits 70% to 100% of its attributes and part of its attack effects. The Doppelganger takes increased damage.
Sun summons a Doppelganger which lasts 8 seconds and inherits 70% of its attributes and part of its attack effects. The Doppelganger takes increased damage.

suyou.description: Casting any skill will put Suyou into her mortal form, granting her 40 movement speed, and reducing the interval between basic attacks. Maintaining any skill will put Suyou into her immortal form, increasing basic attack damage to 125% and granting her physical damage reduction by 20%. In this form, for every 20 additional physical attacks Suyou has, he gains 1% physical damage reduction (up to 40%).

Tap: Suyou throws her weapon in the target direction, dealing damage to enemies in her path. Suyou then blinks at the weapon's location, grabs it, and executes an attack in the opposite direction, dealing. Hold: Suyou channels the power of the Immortal and charges in the target direction, dealing damage to enemies along the way. When hitting an enemy hero, it stops and stuns enemies in a rectangular area in front for 0.6 seconds. The charge increase distance increases with holding time. Suyou can be controlled while charging, but the skill cannot be interrupted.

Tap: Suyou performs a sweeping attack with her weapon, dealing [] to enemies in a fan-shaped area. Hold: Suyou channels the power of the Immortal to perform 3 slashes in a fan-shaped area. The first two hits treat each, while the final hit deals and recovers for itself.

Tap: Suyou slides backwards and swings her weapon in the target direction, dealing 420 (+120% bonus physical attack) physical damage to enemies in a rectangular area and in her path backwards, and reducing their movement speed by 30% for 1.5 seconds. Hold: Suyou uses the power of the Immortal to fire a deadly arrow in the targeted direction, dealing 580 (+165% bonus physical attack) physical damage to the hit target. Range increases with hold time. Suyou can be controlled while charging, but the skill cannot be interrupted.

terizla.description: Terizla gains an additional 1% damage reduction (up to %) for every 2.5% HP lost. He cannot gain any extra attack speed and will convert every 1% extra attack speed he supposedly receives into 1 extra physical attack.

Terizla cracks the ground with her hammer and the crack will expand and attack. Once the crack hits the first target, it will pierce the target and slow them by 30%. At the same time, Terizla's movement speed will be increased by 15-40% for 3.5 seconds. The crack on the target will then explode, dealing damage.

Terizla swings his hammer in a fan-shaped area in front of him. This skill can be cast up to 3 times. The first two attacks deal each, while the third deals. Enemies hit will also be slowed by 20% for 1.5 seconds (the slow effect can stack). Deals only 80-100% damage to minions.

Terizla jumps into the designated area, dealing and knocking down enemies in flight for 0.6 seconds. He then summons a scaffold and slows enemies by 25-45%. The scaffold will hook enemy heroes within range and shoot them multiple times while dealing with them each time.

thamuz.description: Thamuz's basic attacks have a 10-60% chance (depending on Lava Rage) to summon lava energy beneath the target which erupts after a brief delay and deals damage. Basic attacks that do not trigger lava energy will increase Thamuz's lava rage. Without a scythe, Thamuz gains 25% movement speed. After collecting his scythes, his next basic attack slows the target by 30% and is guaranteed to unleash lava energy.

Thamuz throws scythes in the target direction. After traveling a certain distance or hitting the first enemy hero, they deal out. Scythes will then slow nearby enemies by 30% and damage them every 0.5 seconds. After leaving Thamuz for [≈5 seconds] or a certain distance, the scythes will return to Thamuz and drag enemies on their way to him. Thamuz can approach the scythes or cast the skill again to collect them.

Thamuz jumps to a designated area to damage and slow enemy units by 25% for 2 seconds upon landing. If the scythes travel again, they will return to Thamuz and Molten Scythes will instantly reset their CD.

Thamuz releases the lava stored in his body, dealing damage to nearby enemies and creating a Cautering inferno around him. Cauterant Inferno lasts 9 seconds and inflicts enemies in the area every 0.5 seconds. During this time, Thamuz gains additional Max HP, heals for the same amount, and increases his attack speed by 60-100%. He also recovers 1.5-2.5% of his maximum HP each time he deals damage with his basic attacks or scythes.

tigreal.description: Tigreal gains a stack of Dauntless every time he casts an ability or is hit by a basic attack. After gaining 4 charges, Tigreal will consume all of Dauntless's charges to block the next incoming basic attack (including turret attacks). Minion attacks do not grant Fearless Attacks and do not trigger this effect.
Tigreal smashes the ground with her hammer and sends a shockwave forward that erupts 3 times, each time dealing enemies along the fan-shaped area and slowing them by 20%/40%/60% for 1.5 seconds.
